#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# run-ablation.sh — the cycle-130 ablation batch runner (SDD §5.9, §3.4; sprint Task 3.2;
# DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0413, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0428, DEC-0429, DEC-0435, DEC-0545,
# DEC-0553, DEC-0554)
#
# Plans a batch (arm × applicable task × trial), dispatches every trial to
# pipeline-run.sh against a pinned source tree, checks after each trial that the arm
# took effect and that the CLI version and model ids did not drift, grades the run,
# writes its runs.jsonl row, and keeps MANIFEST.json and STATUS.json for the batch.
#
# Usage:
#   run-ablation.sh --arms CSV --source-commit SHA [--tasks CSV] [--types CSV]
#                   [--trials-build N] [--trials-review N] [--max-usd USD] [--run-cap USD]
#                   [--concurrency 3] [--batch NAME] [--results-root DIR] [--rows F]
#                   [--suite-root DIR] [--suite-file F] [--image IMG] [--executor container|host]
#                   [--pre-registration-ref TEXT] [--seed N] [--self-check-log F]
#                   [--smoke] [--dry-run] [--resume] [--detach] [--clear-arm ID]...
#                   [--clear-drift] [--rerow RUN_ID]... [--rerun RUN_ID]... [--rerun-status S]...
#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
#                   [--docker-bin D]
#
# Options:
#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
#   --run-cap USD        per-run cap passed to pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd and reserved per
#                        running trial (default evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
#                        else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12)
#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke
#                        evals/results/ablation-2.0)
#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
#   --resume             continue --batch NAME from its MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and rows
#   --detach             re-exec under setsid nohup (log <batch>/driver.log), print the batch
#                        directory and the pid, exit 0
#   --clear-arm ID       with --resume: remove ID from STATUS.json paused_arms (repeatable)
#   --clear-drift        with --resume: re-read the run named by STATUS.json drift (its run dir
#                        <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>, or the highest -r<k> sibling) with the
#                        current drift guard; none → drift null, an entry in drift_cleared[] and
#                        the batch continues; still a drift → exit 2 printing it, nothing written
#   --rerow RUN_ID       with --resume: run the post-run chain (took-effect, drift guard, grade,
#                        ablation-row.sh with the old row's attempts and retry_reason) again
#                        over the run dir of RUN_ID and replace its one row in place, under the
#                        rows file's flock (temp file beside it, --validate, mv); repeatable;
#                        before reconciliation, so spend and per_arm count the new row once.
#                        Refused (exit 2, nothing written) when RUN_ID is not <batch>-… or not
#                        in the plan, has no row or more than one, has no run dir, or its row
#                        is interrupted or transport_error (those trials are reruns)
#   --rerun RUN_ID       with --resume (DEC-0553): launch RUN_ID again, at its plan index, into a
#                        fresh -r<k> run dir; when its new row lands it replaces the old row in
#                        place (replace_row, under the flock) and STATUS.json rerun[] gets
#                        {run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}. The row must be transport_error,
#                        interrupted or infrastructure_error, else exit 2 with nothing written
#                        (also: not <batch>-…, not in the plan, no row or more than one, or the
#                        same id also given to --rerow); repeatable
#   --rerun-status S     with --resume: rerun every row of the batch whose status is S, one of
#                        transport_error, interrupted, infrastructure_error (anything else is a
#                        usage error); read after the rerows, and a --rerow id is never rerun;
#                        repeatable. A flagged row leaves the done set: no counter and no
#                        assumed charge, only its reported cost stays in spent (it moves to
#                        ledger_usd when the replacement lands); the in-flight reservation
#                        covers the new trial and its row is accounted once when it lands
#   --pipeline-bin P, --grade-bin G, --row-bin R, --took-effect-bin T, --docker-bin D
#                        the five collaborators (defaults: the scripts beside this one, and
#                        $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN else docker)
#
# Pre-flight (any refusal: exit 2, nothing written but <batch>/REFUSED.txt with the reason):
#   1. hard gate, non-smoke batches only (DEC-0435): <suite-root>/MANIFEST.sha256 present,
#      the self-check log present with at least 2 × tasks + review-catch tasks lines
#      `…: PASS` (36 for the sixteen-task suite) and no `: FAIL` line, a REVIEW.md in every
#      <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/; their sha256 go to MANIFEST.json gate
#   2. freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> --suite-file <suite-file> (it runs
#      validate-suite.sh), with --smoke when MANIFEST.sha256 lists a smoke/ path or the batch
#      is a smoke batch (the manifest is checked as it was frozen)
#   3. seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check (the review-catch corpus SHA256SUMS)
#   4. container: the docker CLI and the image (`docker image inspect`)
#   5. the pinned source tree: $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE when set (tests; must be a git tree
#      at the commit, with .claude/), else a detached worktree
#      $LOA_ABLATION_CACHE/ablation-src-<sha12> (default ~/.cache/loa) cut from
#      $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO (default this repository) with git worktree add --detach;
#      it must be at the commit and pristine (git status --porcelain --ignored empty)
#   --resume also refuses when the source commit, the suite manifest hash, the image digest
#   or the CLI version differ from MANIFEST.json, or when STATUS.json records a drift
#   (unless --clear-drift re-reads that run clean under the current rule).
#
# Plan: arms × tasks × trials. An arm whose task_types excludes a task's type is dropped for
# that task with one `refused:` line and never dispatched (DEC-0405). The order is
# trial-major (every arm × task once before any second trial); inside each trial block the
# entries (arm-major, tasks by id) are shuffled with one python3 random.Random(<seed>)
# generator, blocks in trial order (Fisher-Yates via random.shuffle: reproducible for a seed
# across CPython 3.x). run_id = <batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>; run dir <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>,
# a fresh <…>-r<k> (k ≥ 2) for a transport retry or a resumed rerun (the run_id stays).
# --dry-run prints `plan: …`, the `refused:` lines and one line per trial
# `<arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id>`.
#
# Per trial, in order: pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml … --arm … --run-dir … --run-id … --trial …
#   --source-tree <pinned> --suite-file … --executor … --image … --docker-bin …
#   --max-run-usd <run-cap>, output to <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>.log; then
#   1. status from meta/pipeline.json (missing or `running` → interrupted; a missing record
#      is written as a minimal pipeline.json with synthesized_by: run-ablation.sh)
#   2. transport: agent_error plus a provider signature in the failing phase's
#      stderr-<label>.log or events-<label>.jsonl (lib/arms-common.sh
#      is_pipeline_transport_failure) is retried ONCE after $LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S
#      (default 120) into a fresh run dir: attempts 2, retry_reason; the first attempt writes
#      no row and its spent_usd counts in spend; a second transport failure is rowed
#      transport_error. agent_error without the signature is never retried (DEC-0417)
#   3. took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs):
#      a FAIL rows the trial infrastructure_error and pauses the arm (STATUS.json
#      paused_arms; no further trial of it launches until --resume --clear-arm ID) (DEC-0418)
#   4. drift guard (DEC-0407 as amended by DEC-0545): a phase drifts on model grounds only
#      when its model_requested differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the
#      requested model (else the manifest's) is absent from a non-empty models_used (ids
#      normalised as ablation-row.sh does: no Bedrock region prefix, no -vN:M suffix). Any
#      other models_used key is an extra model, telemetry and not drift (Claude Code's
#      WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent): one `run-ablation: extra model <id> in
#      <labels> (<N> output tokens; …)` line in the trial log, the trial result's
#      extra_models and STATUS.json extra_models. The transcripts' system/init
#      claude_code_version (or version) equals MANIFEST cli_version (when neither carries a
#      version, pipeline.json image_digest must equal MANIFEST image_digest). A mismatch rows
#      the trial infrastructure_error, records STATUS.json drift, launches nothing more and
#      fails the batch once the running trials end
#   5. ablation-grade.sh D <task> --suite-root … [--tasks-dir smoke] --executor … --image …
#      --docker-bin … (scored runs that passed 3 and 4; exit 2 → row infrastructure_error)
#   6. ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F --manifest <batch>/MANIFEST.json
#      --attempts N [--retry-reason R] [--status S] --out <job row>; the runner appends the
#      row to the rows file under flock and runs ablation-row.sh --validate on it
#      (--allow-ungraded for smoke) and refuses a run_id rowed twice (state failed)
#   Watchdog (DEC-0429): a trial whose pipeline has no final meta/pipeline.json status after
#   twice its phase-sum timeout (the planned phases' timeout_min: task bounds, else the
#   suite's phase_defaults, BARE = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX) gets SIGTERM to its process
#   group, SIGKILL after $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S (default 60), and is rowed
#   interrupted. $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S replaces the deadline (seconds; tests).
#   Outage breaker (DEC-0554): $LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3; 0 disables) consecutive
#   collected trials rowed transport_error (collection order, any arm; any other collected
#   trial resets the count) stop further launches; the running trials end, STATUS.json outage
#   is set and the batch finishes partial (exit 1): `partial (outage breaker): N consecutive
#   transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back`.
#
# Spend (--max-usd, SDD §5.5 reused through lib/arms-common.sh): before each launch,
#   spent + in_flight × run_cap + est_next > max waits for a running trial and
#   spent + est_next > max cuts (no further launches; STATUS.json cuts[] gets {reason,
#   spent, in_flight_reserved, max, est_next, trials_launched, at_trial}; exit 1).
#   est_next = the mean cost of this arm's completed trials of the task kind (build |
#   review-catch), else the kind's pooled mean, else the suite's cost_hint[kind]. spent =
#   rows' cost_usd + transport first attempts' spent_usd + assumed charges: a trial ending
#   neither completed nor with a reported cost is charged run_cap, a cap_failure is charged
#   max(cost, run_cap); both count in spend.assumed_cap_trials when the charge exceeds the
#   reported cost.
#
# Files: <results-root>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json, run.log, spend.txt,
#   REFUSED.txt, driver.log, .gitignore (non-smoke: the run directories and logs stay out of
#   git), <arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/ (pipeline-run.sh run dirs), <arm>/<task>-t<n>.log};
#   rows to the rows file. MANIFEST.json (§3.4): schema_version, suite, batch, dry_run,
#   smoke, created, source_commit, source_worktree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta (git diff
#   --stat 4d69c3c4..<commit> -- .claude/, ≤ 4,000 chars), harness_commit, harness_dirty,
#   suite_file, suite_root, tasks_dir, rows_file, suite_version, suite_manifest_sha256, arms,
#   tasks, refused, trials_per_type, trials_planned, plan, arm_map, shuffle_seed, shuffle,
#   fingerprint, image, image_digest, executor_mode, cli_version (`docker run --rm --network
#   none <image> claude --version`, host: the CLI's), cli_version_raw, tools, phase_models,
#   caps {cycle_usd, run_usd, reserve_usd, max_usd}, cost_hint, concurrency, retry,
#   watchdog, pre_registration_ref, gate (null for smoke), corpus, agy_opt_in, environment.
#   STATUS.json (§3.4), rewritten after every trial: {schema_version, suite, batch, smoke,
#   state: running|complete|partial|failed, per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_planned, launched,
#   completed, failed (agent_error), excluded (transport_error, infrastructure_error,
#   interrupted, contaminated), cap_failures, degraded, skipped_paused}}, retries: [{run_id,
#   reason, first_attempt_usd}], cuts: [...], paused_arms: {<arm>: reason}, spend: {rows_usd,
#   ledger_usd (transport first attempts, and the reported cost of rows a rerun replaced), spent_usd, max_usd, assumed_cap_trials}, resume_cursor (the
#   index of the first plan entry without a row), drift: null | {run_id, field, expected,
#   got}, drift_cleared: [{run_id, previous, cleared_at, harness_commit}] (--clear-drift),
#   rerowed: [{run_id, from, to, at}] (--rerow), rerun: [{run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}]
#   (--rerun, --rerun-status), rerun_pending: [run_id…] (flagged, no replacement yet), outage:
#   null | {at, consecutive, last_run_id, message} (the breaker), outage_history: [the
#   outages a later --resume cleared], extra_models: {<raw id>: {runs,
#   output_tokens}} ({} when none; derived from extra_models_by_run: {<run_id>: {<raw id>:
#   output_tokens}}, the per-run source a rerow replaces), rows_invalid, started,
#   finished}. At the end the spend.sh line and a batch line go to <batch>/spend.txt.
#
# --resume: reads MANIFEST.json (plan, arms, suite paths, executor, image, run cap, rows
#   file) and STATUS.json (paused_arms, cuts, retries, first-attempt spend); a plan run_id
#   with a row of this batch is done; a trial without a row reruns into a fresh -r<k> run
#   dir (the stale dir is kept); counters and spend are recomputed from the rows.
#   --max-usd and --concurrency may change on resume; --clear-arm, --clear-drift and
#   --rerow need --resume (order: --clear-drift, --rerow and --rerun are checked before the lock,
#   then --rerow replaces rows, then the counters are recomputed with the rerun-flagged rows left
#   out of the done set; the reruns are dispatched with the plan). A resume clears STATUS.json
#   outage (kept under outage_history[]). A start
#   (fresh or resumed) is refused while a process group recorded under <batch>/.jobs/ by an
#   earlier driver (one killed with SIGKILL) is still alive.
#
# Exit: 0 complete (every trial rowed; none transport_error, infrastructure_error,
#       interrupted or contaminated), 1 partial (cut, the outage breaker, a paused arm with trials left, an
#       excluded row, or the driver was signalled), 2 usage or refused, 3 failed (drift, an
#       invalid or duplicated row, no trial completed without a cut, or every arm of the
#       plan paused)
#
# Env: LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE, LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO, LOA_ABLATION_CACHE,
#   LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S,

# Library: lib/arms-common.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal relative path.
# Tested by evals/tests/run-ablation.bats (stub pipeline, grader and docker; no model call).
# =============================================================================

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# lib/arms-common.sh — helpers shared by the two batch runners (cycle-130 Task 3.2)
#
# Sourced (never executed) by evals/harness/run-arms.sh (cycle-129 recall arms) and
# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal
# relative path ./lib/arms-common.sh after `pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR"` (eval.yml trust
# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.
#
# Functions:
#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)
#   fadd <a> <b>               a + b, printed %.10g (awk)
#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)
#   is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
#                              pipeline-run.sh layout: 0 when meta/pipeline.json says
#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.
#   est_record <key> <pool> <cost>   add one completed trial's cost to the key's and the
#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
#                              is lost with the subshell
#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
#                              0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits (reap) while only the
#                              in-flight reservation (${#PIDS[@]} × RUN_CAP) blocks the launch
#
# Globals read: RUN_CAP, MAX_USD, COST_HINT, LAUNCHED, PIDS (array); written: SPENT,
# ASSUMED_CAP, CHARGED_COST, CUT_JSON, EST_KEYS/EST_SUM/EST_N, POOL_KEYS/POOL_SUM/POOL_N (parallel
# arrays: bash 3.2 has no associative arrays). The caller defines log and reap.
# =============================================================================

usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }
fadd() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", a + b }'; }
json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }

# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
# by mentioning a network error).
ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'

is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
  local rd="$1" pipe="$1/meta/pipeline.json" label
  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$pipe" 2>/dev/null)" == "agent_error" ]] || return 1
  label="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true)] as $r
                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,15}$ ]] || return 1
  if grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$rd/transcripts/stderr-$label.log" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
  fi
  local ev="$rd/transcripts/events-$label.jsonl" sig=""
  if [[ -f "$ev" ]]; then
    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$sig" "$label"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1
  local i
  if [[ "$1" == EST ]]; then
    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  else
    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  fi
  echo -1
}
est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
  local i
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
}
est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
  local i p
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  else est_hint "$1"; fi
}

spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
  if [[ "$st" != "completed" ]] && awk -v c="$cost" 'BEGIN { exit !(c + 0 == 0) }'; then
    # audit MEDIUM-A2: a failed trial that reports no cost is charged the run cap
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "assumed cap: $what ended ${st:-without a status} with no reported cost; USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    CHARGED_COST=0
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
    CHARGED_COST="$cost"
  fi
}

budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved
  while true; do
    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}
    reserved="$(awk -v k="$inflight" -v c="$RUN_CAP" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", k * c }')"
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + e > m) }'; then
      CUT_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg s "$SPENT" --arg r "$reserved" --arg m "$MAX_USD" --arg e "$est" \
        --argjson launched "$LAUNCHED" --argjson at "$at" \
        '{reason: "max_usd", spent: ($s | tonumber), in_flight_reserved: ($r | tonumber), max: ($m | tonumber),
          est_next: ($e | tonumber), trials_launched: $launched, at_trial: $at}')"
      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"
      return 1
    fi
    if awk -v s="$SPENT" -v r="$reserved" -v e="$est" -v m="$MAX_USD" 'BEGIN { exit !(s + r + e > m) }'; then
      reap "$inflight"; continue
    fi
    return 0
  done
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# lib/arms-common.sh — helpers shared by the two batch runners (cycle-130 Task 3.2)
#
# Sourced (never executed) by evals/harness/run-arms.sh (cycle-129 recall arms) and
# evals/harness/run-ablation.sh (cycle-130 ablation batches), each by the literal
# relative path ./lib/arms-common.sh after `pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR"` (eval.yml trust
# boundary: no variable on a source line, no .claude/ code). Extracted from
# run-arms.sh without behaviour change; evals/tests/run-arms.bats is the golden check.
#
# Functions:
#   usd_ok <v>                 0 when <v> is an amount in USD (1-6 digits, up to 4 decimals)
#   fadd <a> <b>               a + b, printed %.10g (awk)
#   json_array <v>…            the arguments as a compact JSON string array
#   is_transport_failure <ws>  run-arms layout: <ws>/.eval/{executor.json,agent-output.json,
#                              agent-stderr.log}; 0 when the executor failed for a transport
#                              reason (timeout exit 124/137/143, no result event, API error
#                              status, or a CLI transport message on stderr)
#   is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
#                              pipeline-run.sh layout: 0 when meta/pipeline.json says
#                              agent_error AND the failing phase (the last executed record
#                              with a non-zero exit, else the last executed record) shows a
#                              provider/transport signature: its transcripts/stderr-<label>.log
#                              matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE, or its events-<label>.jsonl holds a
#                              result event with a non-empty api_error_status, or an is_error
#                              result (the CLI's own error, never the agent's text) whose text
#                              starts "API Error" or matches ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE (a usage or
#                              session limit). Assistant messages are never read. A phase timeout is the
#                              model's own account (DEC-0417) and is never transport here.
#                              Prints the signature source (stderr | api_error_status |
#                              api_error_result) and the phase label on success.
#   est_record <key> <pool> <cost>   add one completed trial's cost to the key's and the
#                              pool's means (est_next's inputs)
#   est_next <key> [<pool>]    the next trial's expected cost: the key's mean, else the
#                              pool's mean (default pool "all"), else `est_hint <key>`
#                              (default: $COST_HINT; a runner may redefine est_hint)
#   spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
#                              charge one finished trial to SPENT: a trial that ended
#                              without status completed and without a reported cost is
#                              charged RUN_CAP (ASSUMED_CAP+1, logged); else its cost.
#                              Sets CHARGED_COST to the reported cost it accepted (0 for an
#                              assumed charge); call it directly, never in $( ), or SPENT
#                              is lost with the subshell
#   budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
#                              0 launch; 1 cut (CUT_JSON set). Waits (reap) while only the
#                              in-flight reservation (${#PIDS[@]} × RUN_CAP) blocks the launch
#
# Globals read: RUN_CAP, MAX_USD, COST_HINT, LAUNCHED, PIDS (array); written: SPENT,
# ASSUMED_CAP, CHARGED_COST, CUT_JSON, EST_KEYS/EST_SUM/EST_N, POOL_KEYS/POOL_SUM/POOL_N (parallel
# arrays: bash 3.2 has no associative arrays). The caller defines log and reap.
# =============================================================================

usd_ok() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}(\.[0-9]{1,4})?$ ]]; }
fadd() { awk -v a="$1" -v b="$2" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", a + b }'; }
json_array() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | jq -R . | jq -sc .; }

# The CLI's transport messages (audit r1 DISS-C-005: matched on the CLI's stderr only,
# never on the agent's own output, so the agent under test cannot earn itself a retry
# by mentioning a network error).
ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE='rate.?limit|overloaded|session limit|usage limit|out of extra usage|ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|socket hang up|^(fetch|request) failed|HTTP 5[0-9][0-9]'

is_transport_failure() {  # is_transport_failure <sandbox-ws>
  local ws="$1" out="$1/.eval/agent-output.json" err="$1/.eval/agent-stderr.log" rc
  rc="$(jq -r '.exit_code // 0' "$ws/.eval/executor.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  case "$rc" in 124|137|143) return 0 ;; esac
  [[ "$(jq -r '.subtype // ""' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" == "missing" ]] && return 0
  [[ -n "$(jq -r '.api_error_status // empty' "$out" 2>/dev/null)" ]] && return 0
  grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$err" 2>/dev/null && return 0
  return 1
}

is_pipeline_transport_failure() {  # is_pipeline_transport_failure <run-dir>
  local rd="$1" pipe="$1/meta/pipeline.json" label
  [[ "$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$pipe" 2>/dev/null)" == "agent_error" ]] || return 1
  label="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true)] as $r
                  | ([$r[] | select((.exit // 0) != 0)] | last // ($r | last) // {}) | .label // ""' \
           "$pipe" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{0,15}$ ]] || return 1
  if grep -qiE "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" "$rd/transcripts/stderr-$label.log" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'stderr %s\n' "$label"; return 0
  fi
  local ev="$rd/transcripts/events-$label.jsonl" sig=""
  if [[ -f "$ev" ]]; then
    sig="$(jq -R -r --arg re "$ARMS_TRANSPORT_RE" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "result")
                    | if ((.api_error_status // "") | tostring) != "" then "api_error_status"
                      elif .is_error == true and ((.result // "") | type) == "string"
                           and ((.result // "") | test("^API Error|" + $re; "i")) then "api_error_result"
                      else empty end' "$ev" 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  fi
  if [[ -n "$sig" ]]; then printf '%s %s\n' "$sig" "$label"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

# --- est_next inputs (completed trials only; assumed charges never enter) ---------
EST_KEYS=() EST_SUM=() EST_N=() POOL_KEYS=() POOL_SUM=() POOL_N=()
_est_find() {  # _est_find <EST|POOL> <key> → index or -1

    for i in ${EST_KEYS[@]+"${!EST_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${EST_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  else
    for i in ${POOL_KEYS[@]+"${!POOL_KEYS[@]}"}; do [[ "${POOL_KEYS[$i]}" == "$2" ]] && { echo "$i"; return; }; done
  fi
  echo -1
}
est_record() {  # est_record <key> <pool> <cost>
  local i
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#EST_KEYS[@]}; EST_KEYS[$i]="$1"; EST_SUM[$i]=0; EST_N[$i]=0; fi
  EST_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${EST_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; EST_N[$i]=$(( ${EST_N[$i]} + 1 ))
  i="$(_est_find POOL "$2")"
  if [[ "$i" -lt 0 ]]; then i=${#POOL_KEYS[@]}; POOL_KEYS[$i]="$2"; POOL_SUM[$i]=0; POOL_N[$i]=0; fi
  POOL_SUM[$i]="$(fadd "${POOL_SUM[$i]}" "$3")"; POOL_N[$i]=$(( ${POOL_N[$i]} + 1 ))
}
est_hint() { printf '%s' "$COST_HINT"; }
est_next() {  # est_next <key> [<pool>]
  local i p
  i="$(_est_find EST "$1")"; p="$(_est_find POOL "${2:-all}")"
  if [[ "$i" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${EST_N[$i]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${EST_SUM[$i]}" -v n="${EST_N[$i]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  elif [[ "$p" -ge 0 ]] && [[ "${POOL_N[$p]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
    awk -v s="${POOL_SUM[$p]}" -v n="${POOL_N[$p]}" 'BEGIN { printf "%.10g", s / n }'
  else est_hint "$1"; fi
}

spend_charge() {  # spend_charge <status> <cost> <what>
  local st="$1" cost="$2" what="$3"
  [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0

    CHARGED_COST=0
  else

    CHARGED_COST="$cost"

budget_gate() {  # budget_gate <key> <trial-number> [<pool>]
  local key="$1" at="$2" pool="${3:-all}" est inflight reserved

    est="$(est_next "$key" "$pool")"; inflight=${#PIDS[@]}

      log "cut: max_usd $MAX_USD reached after $LAUNCHED trials (spent $SPENT, in-flight reserved $reserved, next est $est; trial $at not launched; reason recorded in STATUS.json)"

      reap "$inflight"; continue
    fi
    return 0
  done

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ablation-row.sh — one runs.jsonl row per ablation run (cycle-130 FR-6, SDD §3.1, §5.8)
4	#
5	# Joins a run directory's meta/pipeline.json (pipeline-run.sh), its eval/ MODELINV
6	# and cost ledgers, the dissent envelopes eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json (the
7	# harness copies taken when each gate ended; sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/ only
8	# when eval/ has none, for legacy runs — audit MEDIUM-A1), the transcripts' tool
9	# inputs, grade.json (Sprint 259's grader; optional) and the batch MANIFEST.json
10	# (optional) into one SDD §3.1 row, or validates a runs.jsonl file.
11	#
12	# The arm comes from the batch manifest's `arm_map[run_id]`, else from meta/arm,
13	# else from meta/pipeline.json — never from sandbox/ (DEC-0413). A manifest arm that
14	# disagrees with meta/arm is refused (exit 2), and so is an arm outside the grammar
15	# ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ that execute-agent.sh and the mount library enforce (exit 2).
16	#
17	# Derived fields:
18	#   status          pipeline status (completed | agent_error | cap_failure | interrupted |
19	#                   infrastructure_error; a `running` record — driver killed — reads
20	#                   interrupted); grade.json `contaminated` non-null → contaminated;
21	#                   --status overrides (transport_error is the batch runner's call)
22	#   effort_effective per phase: the distinct MODELINV `payload.effort_effective` values of
23	#                   the rows the phase wrote (its `modelinv_lines` range), comma-joined;
24	#                   null when no cheval hop ran (DEC-0419)
25	#   degraded        true when, for any executed phase, (1) the requested model is absent
26	#                   from a non-empty models_used (ids compared without the Bedrock region
27	#                   prefix and the -vN:M suffix); another model beside the requested one (a
28	#                   WebFetch summariser, a built-in subagent) is telemetry, not a
29	#                   degradation (DEC-0545), (2) refusal_fallbacks is non-empty, (3) a MODELINV row's
30	#                   effort_effective differs from the effort it requested (`payload.effort`,
31	#                   else the phase's effort_requested), or (4) a dissent envelope's
32	#                   verdict_quality.status is DEGRADED or its completed voices are fewer
33	#                   than planned; degraded_reason lists every cause ("; "-joined)
34	#   voices_run      {review, audit} from the envelopes ({planned, completed, quality});
35	#                   null when neither envelope exists (A0, A4)
36	#   zone_violations {dot_claude_writes: [{phase, tool, path}]} from Write/Edit/MultiEdit/
37	#                   NotebookEdit tool inputs under .claude/ in transcripts/events-*.jsonl;
38	#                   bash_mount_refs: [{phase, excerpt}] write-shaped Bash tool_use commands
39	#                   naming the mount (excerpt = the first 160 characters): a redirect whose
40	#                   target is a mount path, or a mount path (\.claude/ | CLAUDE\.md |
41	#                   \.loa\.config\.yaml) plus a write-capable command at a command position
42	#                   (sed -i, cp, mv, rm, ln, tee, truncate, install, patch, chmod, chown,
43	#                   git checkout|apply|restore, yq -i, python, perl); reads (cat, ls, grep,
44	#                   sed -n, …) never match. A heuristic that obfuscation can evade: the
45	#                   authoritative after-the-fact checks are pipeline.json mount_integrity
46	#                   and took-effect.sh integrity_clean; mount_changed: the pipeline.json mount_integrity keys that
47	#                   read `changed` (claude_md, loa_config; audit LOW-A2); envelope_mismatch:
48	#                   the gates (review, audit) whose eval/ envelope and sandbox envelope both
49	#                   exist and differ byte for byte (audit MEDIUM-A1)
50	#   cost_usd        Σ phase cost_usd (result.total_cost_usd) + Σ phase ledger_cost_usd
51	#   stalls          number of phases that timed out
52	#
53	# Usage:
54	#   ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F [--grade grade.json] [--manifest MANIFEST.json]
55	#                   [--status S] [--attempts N] [--retry-reason R] [--out runs.jsonl]
56	#   ablation-row.sh --validate runs.jsonl [--allow-ungraded]
57	#
58	# Options:
59	#   --run-dir D        the run directory (meta/, sandbox/, transcripts/, eval/)
60	#   --task-yaml F      the task's task.yaml (id, type)
61	#   --grade F          grade.json (default <run-dir>/grade.json when present; absent →
62	#                      every grade field null, a smoke row)
63	#   --manifest F       batch MANIFEST.json (arm_map, batch, fingerprint, image_digest,
64	#                      suite_manifest_sha256, suite_version, agy_opt_in)
65	#   --status S         override the derived status (one of the seven)
66	#   --attempts N       attempts including transport retries (default 1)
67	#   --retry-reason R   the retry's reason (default null)
68	#   --out F            append the row to F (flock when available); default stdout
69	#   --validate F       check every row's fields, types and enums (the arm grammar, the
70	#                      four zone_violations arrays); exit 1 on the first bad row naming
71	#                      its line number
72	#   --allow-ungraded   with --validate: accept rows whose grade fields are all null
73	#
74	# Exit codes:
75	#   0  row written / file valid
76	#   1  --validate found a bad row
77	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, arm mismatch, or "row build failed for <run_id>"
78	#      (the row program aborted on an input shape it does not handle; no row written)
79	#
80	# Inputs that scale with the run (pipeline.json, MODELINV, grade.json, the manifest,
81	# the envelopes, the transcript write list) reach jq as files under a mktemp -d work
82	# directory (--slurpfile), never as argv strings, so a long run cannot hit the
83	# per-argument limit (MAX_ARG_STRLEN, 128 KiB on Linux). The directory is removed at exit.
84	#
85	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-row.bats (fixture runs under
86	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
87	# =============================================================================
88	set -euo pipefail
89	export LC_ALL=C
90	
91	RUN_DIR="" TASK_YAML="" GRADE="" MANIFEST="" STATUS_OVERRIDE="" ATTEMPTS=1 RETRY_REASON="" OUT=""
92	VALIDATE="" ALLOW_UNGRADED=false
93	usage() { echo "ablation-row.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
94	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
95	  case "$1" in
96	    --run-dir)        RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
97	    --task-yaml)      TASK_YAML="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
98	    --grade)          GRADE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
99	    --manifest)       MANIFEST="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
100	    --status)         STATUS_OVERRIDE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
101	    --attempts)       ATTEMPTS="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
102	    --retry-reason)   RETRY_REASON="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
103	    --out)            OUT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
104	    --validate)       VALIDATE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
105	    --allow-ungraded) ALLOW_UNGRADED=true; shift ;;
106	    -h|--help)        sed -n '2,84p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
107	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
108	  esac
109	done
110	
111	STATUSES='["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","transport_error","infrastructure_error","interrupted","contaminated"]'
112	
113	# --- validate ----------------------------------------------------------------------
114	if [[ -n "$VALIDATE" ]]; then
115	  [[ -f "$VALIDATE" && -r "$VALIDATE" ]] || usage "cannot read $VALIDATE"
116	  n=0 bad=0
117	  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
118	    n=$((n + 1))
119	    [[ -n "${line//[[:space:]]/}" ]] || continue
120	    err="$(jq -r --argjson st "$STATUSES" --argjson ungraded "$ALLOW_UNGRADED" '
121	      def t(v; ts): (v | type) as $ty | (ts | index($ty)) != null;
122	      def need(k; ts): if has(k) | not then "missing field \(k)"
123	                       elif t(.[k]; ts) | not then "field \(k) has type \(.[k] | type), want \(ts | join("|"))"
124	                       else empty end;
125	      def num: ["number"]; def numn: ["number","null"]; def str: ["string"]; def strn: ["string","null"];
126	      def objn: ["object","null"]; def booln: ["boolean","null"];
127	      if type != "object" then "row is not a JSON object" else (.) as $row |
128	      [ need("schema_version"; num), need("run_id"; str), need("batch"; str), need("arm"; str),
129	        need("task_id"; str), need("task_type"; str), need("trial"; num), need("source_commit"; str),
130	        need("suite_manifest_sha256"; strn), need("suite_version"; ["number","string","null"]),
131	        need("host_fingerprint"; strn), need("image_digest"; strn), need("agy_opt_in"; ["boolean"]),
132	        need("started"; str), need("finished"; strn), need("phases"; ["array"]),
133	        need("voices_run"; objn), need("hidden_tests"; objn), need("hidden_test_pass_rate"; numn),
134	        need("defects_seeded"; numn), need("defects_caught"; numn), need("defect_catch_rate"; numn),
135	        need("flags"; numn), need("false_positives"; numn), need("verdict"; strn),
136	        need("verdict_accuracy"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_review"; booln), need("verdict_accuracy_audit"; booln),
137	        need("regressions"; numn), need("diff_lines"; numn), need("files_changed"; numn),
138	        need("cost_usd"; num), need("wall_clock_ms"; num), need("tokens_in"; num), need("tokens_out"; num),
139	        need("stalls"; num), need("attempts"; num), need("retry_reason"; strn),
140	        need("degraded"; ["boolean"]), need("degraded_reason"; strn), need("status"; str),
141	        need("snapshots"; ["object"]), need("contaminated"; objn), need("zone_violations"; ["object"]) ][0]
142	      // (if (["feature-build","bug-fix","refactor","review-catch"] | index($row.task_type)) == null
143	           then "task_type \(.task_type) is not one of feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch" else empty end)
144	      // (if ($st | index($row.status)) == null then "status \(.status) is not one of \($st | join("|"))" else empty end)
145	      // (if ($row.arm | test("^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$")) | not then "arm \(.arm) does not match the arm grammar" else empty end)
146	      // ([("dot_claude_writes", "bash_mount_refs", "mount_changed", "envelope_mismatch") as $k
147	           | select((($row.zone_violations | objects)[$k] | type) != "array") | "zone_violations.\($k) is not an array"][0])
148	      // (if (.degraded == true) and (.degraded_reason == null) then "degraded without degraded_reason" else empty end)
149	      // (if .verdict != null and ((["APPROVED","CHANGES_REQUIRED"] | index($row.verdict)) == null)
150	           then "verdict \(.verdict) is not APPROVED|CHANGES_REQUIRED" else empty end)
151	      // ([.snapshots | to_entries[] | select((.value | type) != "string" and (.value | type) != "null")
152	           | "snapshots.\(.key) is not a string"][0])
153	      // ([.phases | to_entries[] | .key as $i | .value as $p
154	           | ( if ($p | type) != "object" then "phases[\($i)] is not an object" else
155	               ([ ($p | need("name"; str)), ($p | need("session_id"; strn)), ($p | need("model_requested"; str)),
156	                  ($p | need("models_used"; ["object"])), ($p | need("effort_requested"; strn)),
157	                  ($p | need("effort_effective"; strn)), ($p | need("tokens_in"; num)), ($p | need("tokens_out"; num)),
158	                  ($p | need("cache_read_tokens"; num)), ($p | need("cache_creation_tokens"; num)),
159	                  ($p | need("cost_usd"; num)), ($p | need("duration_ms"; num)), ($p | need("num_turns"; num)),
160	                  ($p | need("exit"; num)), ($p | need("refusal_fallbacks"; ["array"])) ][0]
161	                | if . then "phases[\($i)]: \(.)" else empty end) end )][0])
162	      // (if $ungraded then empty
163	          elif (["completed","cap_failure","agent_error","contaminated"] | index($row.status)) == null then empty
164	          elif .task_type == "review-catch" then
165	            (if (.defect_catch_rate | type) != "number" then "graded review-catch row has no defect_catch_rate (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
166	          else
167	            (if (.hidden_tests | type) != "object" or (.hidden_test_pass_rate | type) != "number"
168	               then "graded build row has no hidden_tests (use --allow-ungraded for smoke rows)" else empty end)
169	          end)
170	      // empty
171	      end' 2>/dev/null <<<"$line")" || err="line is not valid JSON"
172	    if [[ -n "$err" ]]; then
173	      echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE:$n: $err" >&2
174	      exit 1
175	    fi
176	  done < "$VALIDATE"
177	  echo "ablation-row.sh: $VALIDATE: $n rows valid"
178	  exit 0
179	fi
180	
181	# --- build a row -------------------------------------------------------------------------
182	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "missing --run-dir (or --validate)"
183	[[ -n "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "missing --task-yaml"
184	[[ -f "$TASK_YAML" ]] || usage "task yaml not found: $TASK_YAML"
185	PIPE="$RUN_DIR/meta/pipeline.json"
186	[[ -f "$PIPE" ]] || usage "no meta/pipeline.json under $RUN_DIR"
187	jq -e 'type == "object"' "$PIPE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
188	[[ "$ATTEMPTS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || usage "--attempts must be an integer"
189	if [[ -n "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" ]] && ! jq -e --arg s "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" 'index($s) != null' <<<"$STATUSES" >/dev/null; then
190	  usage "--status must be one of $(jq -r 'join("|")' <<<"$STATUSES")"
191	fi
192	
193	# Every input that scales with the run reaches jq as a file (--slurpfile), never as an
194	# argv string: one argument is capped at MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB on Linux), and the
195	# MODELINV ledger of a long run passes it. Scalars stay --arg.
196	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ablation-row.XXXXXX")" || usage "cannot create a work directory"
197	cleanup() { find "$WORK" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
198	trap cleanup EXIT
199	
200	[[ -n "$GRADE" ]] || { [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/grade.json" ]] && GRADE="$RUN_DIR/grade.json"; } || true
201	echo null > "$WORK/grade.json"
202	if [[ -n "$GRADE" ]]; then
203	  [[ -f "$GRADE" ]] || usage "grade file not found: $GRADE"
204	  jq -c '.' "$GRADE" > "$WORK/grade.json" || usage "grade file does not parse: $GRADE"
205	fi
206	echo '{}' > "$WORK/manifest.json"
207	if [[ -n "$MANIFEST" ]]; then
208	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || usage "manifest not found: $MANIFEST"
209	  jq -c '.' "$MANIFEST" > "$WORK/manifest.json" || usage "manifest does not parse: $MANIFEST"
210	fi
211	yq -o=json '.' "$TASK_YAML" > "$WORK/task.json" || usage "task yaml does not parse"
212	jq -c '.' "$PIPE" > "$WORK/pipe.json" || usage "meta/pipeline.json does not parse"
213	RUN_ID="$(jq -r '.run_id // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")"
214	
215	# arm: manifest arm_map > meta/arm > pipeline.json; never sandbox/
216	META_ARM=""
217	[[ -f "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" ]] && META_ARM="$(sed -n '1p' "$RUN_DIR/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
218	MAN_ARM="$(jq -r --arg r "$RUN_ID" '.arm_map[$r] // empty' "$WORK/manifest.json")"
219	if [[ -n "$MAN_ARM" && -n "$META_ARM" && "$MAN_ARM" != "$META_ARM" ]]; then
220	  usage "arm mismatch for $RUN_ID: manifest arm_map says $MAN_ARM, meta/arm says $META_ARM"
221	fi
222	ARM="${MAN_ARM:-${META_ARM:-$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$WORK/pipe.json")}}"
223	[[ -n "$ARM" ]] || usage "no arm for $RUN_ID (manifest arm_map, meta/arm, pipeline.json)"
224	[[ "$ARM" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || usage "arm '$ARM' does not match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$"
225	
226	# MODELINV rows as an array with their 1-based line numbers
227	echo '[]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
228	if [[ -f "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
229	  awk '{print NR "\t" $0}' "$RUN_DIR/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" \
230	    | jq -R -n -c '[inputs | split("\t") | {line: (.[0] | tonumber), row: (.[1:] | join("\t") | fromjson? // null)}
231	                   | select(.row != null)]' > "$WORK/minv.json"
232	fi
233	
234	# the dissent envelopes: eval/ (copied by the harness when the gate ended) first; the
235	# sandbox copy (the agent's tree) only when eval/ has none (audit MEDIUM-A1)
236	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → JSON or null
237	  local f="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
238	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
239	  if [[ -f "$f" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -c '.' "$f"; else echo null; fi
240	}
241	envelope review > "$WORK/env-review.json"
242	envelope audit > "$WORK/env-audit.json"
243	mismatch=()
244	for g in review audit; do
245	  e="$RUN_DIR/eval/adversarial-$g.json" sb="$RUN_DIR/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$g.json"
246	  if [[ -f "$e" && -f "$sb" ]] && ! cmp -s "$e" "$sb"; then mismatch+=("$g"); fi
247	done
248	printf '%s\n' ${mismatch[@]+"${mismatch[@]}"} | jq -R -s -c 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))' > "$WORK/mismatch.json"
249	
250	# Write/Edit tool inputs under .claude/ from every transcript
251	echo '[]' > "$WORK/dot.json"
252	shopt -s nullglob
253	ev_files=("$RUN_DIR"/transcripts/events-*.jsonl)
254	shopt -u nullglob
255	if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
256	  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
257	      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
258	      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
259	        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use"
260	                 and (.name == "Write" or .name == "Edit" or .name == "MultiEdit" or .name == "NotebookEdit"))
261	        | {phase: $ph, tool: .name, path: (.input.file_path // .input.notebook_path // "")}
262	        | select(.path | test("(^|/)\\.claude/"))' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
263	    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/dot.json"
264	fi
265	# Write-shaped Bash commands toward the mount (audit LOW-A2): sed -i, cp or a redirect into
266	# .claude/, CLAUDE.md or .loa.config.yaml leaves no Write/Edit input. Reads of the mount are
267	# normal skill operation and are not listed (prong 1: a redirect to a mount path; prong 2: a
268	# mount path plus a write-capable command token at a command position).
269	echo '[]' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
270	if [[ ${#ev_files[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
271	  for f in "${ev_files[@]}"; do
272	      lab="$(basename "$f" .jsonl)"; lab="${lab#events-}"
273	      jq -R -c --arg ph "$lab" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .type == "assistant") | .message.content[]?
274	        | select(type == "object" and .type == "tool_use" and .name == "Bash")
275	        | (.input | objects | .command) | strings
276	        | select(test(">>?[[:space:]]*[^[:space:];&|]*(\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml)")
277	                 or (test("\\.claude/|CLAUDE\\.md|\\.loa\\.config\\.yaml")
278	                     and test("(^|[;&|(][[:space:]]*|\\bthen[[:space:]]+|\\bdo[[:space:]]+)(sed[[:space:]]+-[a-zA-Z]*i|cp|mv|rm|ln|tee|truncate|install|patch|chmod|chown|git[[:space:]]+(checkout|apply|restore)|yq[[:space:]]+-i|python3?|perl)\\b")))
279	        | {phase: $ph, excerpt: .[0:160]}' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
280	    done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/bashref.json"
281	fi
282	
283	# Each --slurpfile binds an array of the file's values; [0] is the one value.
284	ROW="$(jq -n -c \
285	  --slurpfile p_f "$WORK/pipe.json" --slurpfile task_f "$WORK/task.json" --slurpfile g_f "$WORK/grade.json" \
286	  --slurpfile m_f "$WORK/manifest.json" --slurpfile minv_f "$WORK/minv.json" \
287	  --slurpfile er_f "$WORK/env-review.json" --slurpfile ea_f "$WORK/env-audit.json" --slurpfile dot_f "$WORK/dot.json" \
288	  --slurpfile bash_f "$WORK/bashref.json" --slurpfile mm_f "$WORK/mismatch.json" \
289	  --arg arm "$ARM" --arg status_override "$STATUS_OVERRIDE" --argjson attempts "$ATTEMPTS" \
290	  --arg retry_reason "$RETRY_REASON" '
291	  def norm_model: tostring | sub("^([a-z]+\\.)?anthropic\\."; "") | sub("-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$"; "");
292	  # an unparseable timestamp (empty, an offset other than Z, not a string) is null, never an abort
293	  def ms(ts): if ts == null or ts == "" then null
294	              else (try (ts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | fromdateiso8601 * 1000) catch null) end;
295	  def obj: if type == "object" then . else {} end;
296	  def boolish: if type == "boolean" then . else null end;
297	  def voices(e): if e == null then null else
298	      (e.verdict_quality | obj) as $vq
299	      | {planned: ($vq.voices_planned // e.voices_planned // null),
300	         completed: ($vq.voices_succeeded // e.voices_succeeded // null),
301	         quality: ($vq.status // e.status // null),
302	         companion_planned: first((e.metadata | objects | .companion_voice | objects | .planned), null)} end;
303	  $p_f[0] as $p | $task_f[0] as $task | $g_f[0] as $g | $m_f[0] as $m | $minv_f[0] as $minv
304	  | $er_f[0] as $er | $ea_f[0] as $ea | $dot_f[0] as $dot | $bash_f[0] as $bashref | $mm_f[0] as $mismatch
305	  | ($p.phases // [] | map(select(.skipped != true))) as $ran
306	  | [ $ran[] as $ph
307	      | ($minv | map(select(.line >= ($ph.modelinv_lines.from // 1e18) and .line <= ($ph.modelinv_lines.to // -1)) | .row)) as $rows
308	      | ([$rows[] | .payload.effort_effective // .effort_effective // empty] | unique) as $eff
309	      | $ph + {
310	          effort_effective: (if ($eff | length) == 0 then null else ($eff | join(",")) end),
311	          voice_cost_usd: (([$rows[] | .payload.cost_micro_usd // .cost_micro_usd // 0] | add // 0) / 1000000),
312	          effort_mismatches: [ $rows[] | (.payload // .) as $r
313	                               | ($r.effort // $ph.effort_requested // null) as $want
314	                               | select($r.effort_effective != null and $want != null and $r.effort_effective != $want)
315	                               | "\($r.calling_primitive // "hop") effort \($want)->\($r.effort_effective)" ],
316	          # DEC-0545: a substitution (the requested model absent from a non-empty models_used)
317	          # degrades; an extra model beside the requested one is telemetry
318	          model_missing: ( ($ph.models_used // {} | objects // {}) as $mu
319	                           | if ($mu | length) > 0 and ($ph.model_requested | type) == "string" and $ph.model_requested != ""
320	                                and ([$mu | keys[] | norm_model] | any(. == ($ph.model_requested | norm_model)) | not)
321	                             then [$mu | keys | join(", ")] else [] end )
322	        } ] as $phases
323	  | ( [ $phases[] | .label as $l
324	        | .model_requested as $req
325	        | ( .model_missing[] | "\($l): requested \($req) absent from models_used (\(.))" ),
326	          ( if (.refusal_fallbacks | length) > 0 then "\($l): refusal fallback" else empty end ),
327	          ( .effort_mismatches[] | "\($l): MODELINV \(.)" ) ]
328	      + [ (["review", $er], ["audit", $ea]) | (.) as [$gate, $e] | select($e != null)
329	          | voices($e) as $v
330	          | ( if $v.quality == "DEGRADED" then "\($gate) envelope verdict_quality DEGRADED" else empty end ),
331	            ( if ($v.planned != null and $v.completed != null and $v.completed < $v.planned)
332	                then "\($gate) envelope \($v.completed) of \($v.planned) voices completed" else empty end ) ]
333	    ) as $why
334	  | ($p.status // "infrastructure_error" | if . == "running" then "interrupted" else . end) as $pst
335	  | (if $status_override != "" then $status_override
336	     elif ($g != null and ($g.contaminated // null) != null) then "contaminated"
337	     else $pst end) as $status
338	  | ($g.hidden_tests // null | if type == "object" then {passed: (.passed // 0), total: (.total // 0)} else null end) as $ht
339	  | ($g.recall // null) as $rc
340	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_seeded // $rc.seeded // $rc.total // null) end) as $seeded
341	  | (if $rc == null then null else ($rc.defects_caught // $rc.caught // null) end) as $caught
342	  | ms($p.started) as $t0 | ms($p.finished) as $t1
343	  | {
344	      schema_version: 1,
345	      run_id: ($p.run_id // ""),
346	      batch: ($m.batch // $m.batch_name // "unbatched"),
347	      arm: $arm,
348	      task_id: ($task.id // $p.task_id // ""),
349	      task_type: ($task.type // $p.task_type // ""),
350	      trial: ($p.trial // 0),
351	      source_commit: ($p.source_commit // $m.source_commit // ""),
352	      suite_manifest_sha256: ($m.suite_manifest_sha256 // null),
353	      suite_version: ($m.suite_version // $p.suite_version // $task.suite_version // null),
354	      host_fingerprint: ($m.fingerprint // $p.fingerprint // null),
355	      image_digest: ($m.image_digest // $p.image_digest // null),
356	      executor_mode: ($m.executor_mode // $p.executor_mode // null),
357	      agy_opt_in: ($m.agy_opt_in // false),
358	      started: ($p.started // ""),
359	      finished: ($p.finished // null),
360	      phases: [ $phases[] | {name: (.name // .label // ""), label, session_id,
361	                             model_requested: (.model_requested // ""), models_used: (.models_used // {} | obj),
362	                             effort_requested, effort_effective,
363	                             tokens_in: (.tokens_in // 0), tokens_out: (.tokens_out // 0),
364	                             cache_read_tokens: (.cache_read_tokens // 0), cache_creation_tokens: (.cache_creation_tokens // 0),
365	                             cost_usd: (.cost_usd // 0), voice_cost_usd, ledger_cost_usd: (.ledger_cost_usd // 0),
366	                             duration_ms: (.duration_ms // 0), num_turns: (.num_turns // 0), exit: (.exit // -1),
367	                             timed_out: (.timed_out // false), refusal_fallbacks: (.refusal_fallbacks // []),
368	                             snapshot: (.snapshot // null), verdict: (.verdict // null)} ],
369	      voices_run: (if $er == null and $ea == null then null else {review: voices($er), audit: voices($ea)} end),
370	      hidden_tests: $ht,
