1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# run-ablation.sh — the cycle-130 ablation batch runner (SDD §5.9, §3.4; sprint Task 3.2;
4	# DEC-0405, DEC-0407, DEC-0413, DEC-0417, DEC-0418, DEC-0428, DEC-0429, DEC-0435, DEC-0545,
5	# DEC-0553, DEC-0554)
6	#
7	# Plans a batch (arm × applicable task × trial), dispatches every trial to
8	# pipeline-run.sh against a pinned source tree, checks after each trial that the arm
9	# took effect and that the CLI version and model ids did not drift, grades the run,
10	# writes its runs.jsonl row, and keeps MANIFEST.json and STATUS.json for the batch.
11	#
12	# Usage:
13	#   run-ablation.sh --arms CSV --source-commit SHA [--tasks CSV] [--types CSV]
14	#                   [--trials-build N] [--trials-review N] [--max-usd USD] [--run-cap USD]
15	#                   [--concurrency 3] [--batch NAME] [--results-root DIR] [--rows F]
16	#                   [--suite-root DIR] [--suite-file F] [--image IMG] [--executor container|host]
17	#                   [--pre-registration-ref TEXT] [--seed N] [--self-check-log F]
18	#                   [--smoke] [--dry-run] [--resume] [--detach] [--clear-arm ID]...
19	#                   [--clear-drift] [--rerow RUN_ID]... [--rerun RUN_ID]... [--rerun-status S]...
20	#                   [--pipeline-bin P] [--grade-bin G] [--row-bin R] [--took-effect-bin T]
21	#                   [--docker-bin D]
22	#
23	# Options:
24	#   --arms CSV           arm ids in the order given (default: the suite's priority minus
25	#                        every arm declared absent: true); each must be declared
26	#   --source-commit SHA  the Loa commit the arms run (the pinned source tree)
27	#   --tasks CSV          task ids (default: every <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml;
28	#                        --smoke: every smoke/<id>/)
29	#   --types CSV          keep tasks of these types (feature-build, bug-fix, refactor,
30	#                        review-catch; `build` = the three build types)
31	#   --trials-build N     trials per build task (default the suite's trials.build; --smoke 1)
32	#   --trials-review N    trials per review-catch task (default trials.review-catch; --smoke 1)
33	#   --max-usd USD        batch spend cap (see Spend); no cap when absent
34	#   --run-cap USD        per-run cap passed to pipeline-run.sh --max-run-usd and reserved per
35	#                        running trial (default evals.ablation.run_cap_usd in .loa.config.yaml,
36	#                        else the suite's caps.run_usd, else 12)
37	#   --concurrency N      trials at once, 1-9 (default 3)
38	#   --batch NAME         batch directory name (default batch-<UTC ts>; --smoke smoke-<UTC ts>;
39	#                        the smoke- prefix is reserved for --smoke)
40	#   --results-root DIR   where batch directories live (default
41	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/batches; --smoke
42	#                        evals/results/ablation-2.0)
43	#   --rows F             the rows file (default: --smoke <batch>/rows.jsonl; otherwise
44	#                        grimoires/loa/reports/ablation-2.0/runs.jsonl, the tracked file, or
45	#                        <results-root>/runs.jsonl when --results-root is given). A smoke
46	#                        batch never writes the tracked file (DEC-0428: smoke rows decide nothing)
47	#   --suite-root DIR     suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
48	#   --suite-file F       suite file (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml)
49	#   --image IMG          container image (default loa-ablation:258)
50	#   --executor MODE      container (default) or host; passed to pipeline-run.sh and the grader
51	#                        (host grading needs LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1, see ablation-grade.sh)
52	#   --pre-registration-ref TEXT  the NOTES pre-registration heading and timestamp (MANIFEST)
53	#   --seed N             shuffle seed (default 20261015)
54	#   --self-check-log F   the recorded image self-check (default
55	#                        grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-259/self-check-image.log)
56	#   --smoke              smoke batch: smoke/ tasks, one trial each, no hard gate, own rows
57	#   --dry-run            run the pre-flight, print the plan, write MANIFEST.json only
58	#                        (MANIFEST.dry-run.json when the batch already has a STATUS.json)
59	#   --resume             continue --batch NAME from its MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json and rows
60	#   --detach             re-exec under setsid nohup (log <batch>/driver.log), print the batch
61	#                        directory and the pid, exit 0
62	#   --clear-arm ID       with --resume: remove ID from STATUS.json paused_arms (repeatable)
63	#   --clear-drift        with --resume: re-read the run named by STATUS.json drift (its run dir
64	#                        <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>, or the highest -r<k> sibling) with the
65	#                        current drift guard; none → drift null, an entry in drift_cleared[] and
66	#                        the batch continues; still a drift → exit 2 printing it, nothing written
67	#   --rerow RUN_ID       with --resume: run the post-run chain (took-effect, drift guard, grade,
68	#                        ablation-row.sh with the old row's attempts and retry_reason) again
69	#                        over the run dir of RUN_ID and replace its one row in place, under the
70	#                        rows file's flock (temp file beside it, --validate, mv); repeatable;
71	#                        before reconciliation, so spend and per_arm count the new row once.
72	#                        Refused (exit 2, nothing written) when RUN_ID is not <batch>-… or not
73	#                        in the plan, has no row or more than one, has no run dir, or its row
74	#                        is interrupted or transport_error (those trials are reruns)
75	#   --rerun RUN_ID       with --resume (DEC-0553): launch RUN_ID again, at its plan index, into a
76	#                        fresh -r<k> run dir; when its new row lands it replaces the old row in
77	#                        place (replace_row, under the flock) and STATUS.json rerun[] gets
78	#                        {run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}. The row must be transport_error,
79	#                        interrupted or infrastructure_error, else exit 2 with nothing written
80	#                        (also: not <batch>-…, not in the plan, no row or more than one, or the
81	#                        same id also given to --rerow); repeatable
82	#   --rerun-status S     with --resume: rerun every row of the batch whose status is S, one of
83	#                        transport_error, interrupted, infrastructure_error (anything else is a
84	#                        usage error); read after the rerows, and a --rerow id is never rerun;
85	#                        repeatable. A flagged row leaves the done set: no counter and no
86	#                        assumed charge, only its reported cost stays in spent (it moves to
87	#                        ledger_usd when the replacement lands); the in-flight reservation
88	#                        covers the new trial and its row is accounted once when it lands
89	#   --pipeline-bin P, --grade-bin G, --row-bin R, --took-effect-bin T, --docker-bin D
90	#                        the five collaborators (defaults: the scripts beside this one, and
91	#                        $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN else docker)
92	#
93	# Pre-flight (any refusal: exit 2, nothing written but <batch>/REFUSED.txt with the reason):
94	#   1. hard gate, non-smoke batches only (DEC-0435): <suite-root>/MANIFEST.sha256 present,
95	#      the self-check log present with at least 2 × tasks + review-catch tasks lines
96	#      `…: PASS` (36 for the sixteen-task suite) and no `: FAIL` line, a REVIEW.md in every
97	#      <suite-root>/tasks/<id>/; their sha256 go to MANIFEST.json gate
98	#   2. freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> --suite-file <suite-file> (it runs
99	#      validate-suite.sh), with --smoke when MANIFEST.sha256 lists a smoke/ path or the batch
100	#      is a smoke batch (the manifest is checked as it was frozen)
101	#   3. seed-corpus-from-record.sh --check (the review-catch corpus SHA256SUMS)
102	#   4. container: the docker CLI and the image (`docker image inspect`)
103	#   5. the pinned source tree: $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE when set (tests; must be a git tree
104	#      at the commit, with .claude/), else a detached worktree
105	#      $LOA_ABLATION_CACHE/ablation-src-<sha12> (default ~/.cache/loa) cut from
106	#      $LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO (default this repository) with git worktree add --detach;
107	#      it must be at the commit and pristine (git status --porcelain --ignored empty)
108	#   --resume also refuses when the source commit, the suite manifest hash, the image digest
109	#   or the CLI version differ from MANIFEST.json, or when STATUS.json records a drift
110	#   (unless --clear-drift re-reads that run clean under the current rule).
111	#
112	# Plan: arms × tasks × trials. An arm whose task_types excludes a task's type is dropped for
113	# that task with one `refused:` line and never dispatched (DEC-0405). The order is
114	# trial-major (every arm × task once before any second trial); inside each trial block the
115	# entries (arm-major, tasks by id) are shuffled with one python3 random.Random(<seed>)
116	# generator, blocks in trial order (Fisher-Yates via random.shuffle: reproducible for a seed
117	# across CPython 3.x). run_id = <batch>-<arm>-<task>-t<n>; run dir <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>,
118	# a fresh <…>-r<k> (k ≥ 2) for a transport retry or a resumed rerun (the run_id stays).
119	# --dry-run prints `plan: …`, the `refused:` lines and one line per trial
120	# `<arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id>`.
121	#
122	# Per trial, in order: pipeline-run.sh --task-yaml … --arm … --run-dir … --run-id … --trial …
123	#   --source-tree <pinned> --suite-file … --executor … --image … --docker-bin …
124	#   --max-run-usd <run-cap>, output to <batch>/<arm>/<task>-t<n>.log; then
125	#   1. status from meta/pipeline.json (missing or `running` → interrupted; a missing record
126	#      is written as a minimal pipeline.json with synthesized_by: run-ablation.sh)
127	#   2. transport: agent_error plus a provider signature in the failing phase's
128	#      stderr-<label>.log or events-<label>.jsonl (lib/arms-common.sh
129	#      is_pipeline_transport_failure) is retried ONCE after $LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S
130	#      (default 120) into a fresh run dir: attempts 2, retry_reason; the first attempt writes
131	#      no row and its spent_usd counts in spend; a second transport failure is rowed
132	#      transport_error. agent_error without the signature is never retried (DEC-0417)
133	#   3. took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs):
134	#      a FAIL rows the trial infrastructure_error and pauses the arm (STATUS.json
135	#      paused_arms; no further trial of it launches until --resume --clear-arm ID) (DEC-0418)
136	#   4. drift guard (DEC-0407 as amended by DEC-0545): a phase drifts on model grounds only
137	#      when its model_requested differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the
138	#      requested model (else the manifest's) is absent from a non-empty models_used (ids
139	#      normalised as ablation-row.sh does: no Bedrock region prefix, no -vN:M suffix). Any
140	#      other models_used key is an extra model, telemetry and not drift (Claude Code's
141	#      WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent): one `run-ablation: extra model <id> in
142	#      <labels> (<N> output tokens; …)` line in the trial log, the trial result's
143	#      extra_models and STATUS.json extra_models. The transcripts' system/init
144	#      claude_code_version (or version) equals MANIFEST cli_version (when neither carries a
145	#      version, pipeline.json image_digest must equal MANIFEST image_digest). A mismatch rows
146	#      the trial infrastructure_error, records STATUS.json drift, launches nothing more and
147	#      fails the batch once the running trials end
148	#   5. ablation-grade.sh D <task> --suite-root … [--tasks-dir smoke] --executor … --image …
149	#      --docker-bin … (scored runs that passed 3 and 4; exit 2 → row infrastructure_error)
150	#   6. ablation-row.sh --run-dir D --task-yaml F --manifest <batch>/MANIFEST.json
151	#      --attempts N [--retry-reason R] [--status S] --out <job row>; the runner appends the
152	#      row to the rows file under flock and runs ablation-row.sh --validate on it
153	#      (--allow-ungraded for smoke) and refuses a run_id rowed twice (state failed)
154	#   Watchdog (DEC-0429): a trial whose pipeline has no final meta/pipeline.json status after
155	#   twice its phase-sum timeout (the planned phases' timeout_min: task bounds, else the
156	#   suite's phase_defaults, BARE = PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 × FIX) gets SIGTERM to its process
157	#   group, SIGKILL after $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S (default 60), and is rowed
158	#   interrupted. $LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S replaces the deadline (seconds; tests).
159	#   Outage breaker (DEC-0554): $LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3; 0 disables) consecutive
160	#   collected trials rowed transport_error (collection order, any arm; any other collected
161	#   trial resets the count) stop further launches; the running trials end, STATUS.json outage
162	#   is set and the batch finishes partial (exit 1): `partial (outage breaker): N consecutive
163	#   transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back`.
164	#
165	# Spend (--max-usd, SDD §5.5 reused through lib/arms-common.sh): before each launch,
166	#   spent + in_flight × run_cap + est_next > max waits for a running trial and
167	#   spent + est_next > max cuts (no further launches; STATUS.json cuts[] gets {reason,
168	#   spent, in_flight_reserved, max, est_next, trials_launched, at_trial}; exit 1).
169	#   est_next = the mean cost of this arm's completed trials of the task kind (build |
170	#   review-catch), else the kind's pooled mean, else the suite's cost_hint[kind]. spent =
171	#   rows' cost_usd + transport first attempts' spent_usd + assumed charges: a trial ending
172	#   neither completed nor with a reported cost is charged run_cap, a cap_failure is charged
173	#   max(cost, run_cap); both count in spend.assumed_cap_trials when the charge exceeds the
174	#   reported cost.
175	#
176	# Files: <results-root>/<batch>/{MANIFEST.json, STATUS.json, run.log, spend.txt,
177	#   REFUSED.txt, driver.log, .gitignore (non-smoke: the run directories and logs stay out of
178	#   git), <arm>/<task>-t<n>[-r<k>]/ (pipeline-run.sh run dirs), <arm>/<task>-t<n>.log};
179	#   rows to the rows file. MANIFEST.json (§3.4): schema_version, suite, batch, dry_run,
180	#   smoke, created, source_commit, source_worktree, source_commit_dot_claude_delta (git diff
181	#   --stat 4d69c3c4..<commit> -- .claude/, ≤ 4,000 chars), harness_commit, harness_dirty,
182	#   suite_file, suite_root, tasks_dir, rows_file, suite_version, suite_manifest_sha256, arms,
183	#   tasks, refused, trials_per_type, trials_planned, plan, arm_map, shuffle_seed, shuffle,
184	#   fingerprint, image, image_digest, executor_mode, cli_version (`docker run --rm --network
185	#   none <image> claude --version`, host: the CLI's), cli_version_raw, tools, phase_models,
186	#   caps {cycle_usd, run_usd, reserve_usd, max_usd}, cost_hint, concurrency, retry,
187	#   watchdog, pre_registration_ref, gate (null for smoke), corpus, agy_opt_in, environment.
188	#   STATUS.json (§3.4), rewritten after every trial: {schema_version, suite, batch, smoke,
189	#   state: running|complete|partial|failed, per_arm: {<arm>: {trials_planned, launched,
190	#   completed, failed (agent_error), excluded (transport_error, infrastructure_error,
191	#   interrupted, contaminated), cap_failures, degraded, skipped_paused}}, retries: [{run_id,
192	#   reason, first_attempt_usd}], cuts: [...], paused_arms: {<arm>: reason}, spend: {rows_usd,
193	#   ledger_usd (transport first attempts, and the reported cost of rows a rerun replaced), spent_usd, max_usd, assumed_cap_trials}, resume_cursor (the
194	#   index of the first plan entry without a row), drift: null | {run_id, field, expected,
195	#   got}, drift_cleared: [{run_id, previous, cleared_at, harness_commit}] (--clear-drift),
196	#   rerowed: [{run_id, from, to, at}] (--rerow), rerun: [{run_id, from, to, old_cost_usd, at}]
197	#   (--rerun, --rerun-status), rerun_pending: [run_id…] (flagged, no replacement yet), outage:
198	#   null | {at, consecutive, last_run_id, message} (the breaker), outage_history: [the
199	#   outages a later --resume cleared], extra_models: {<raw id>: {runs,
200	#   output_tokens}} ({} when none; derived from extra_models_by_run: {<run_id>: {<raw id>:
201	#   output_tokens}}, the per-run source a rerow replaces), rows_invalid, started,
202	#   finished}. At the end the spend.sh line and a batch line go to <batch>/spend.txt.
203	#
204	# --resume: reads MANIFEST.json (plan, arms, suite paths, executor, image, run cap, rows
205	#   file) and STATUS.json (paused_arms, cuts, retries, first-attempt spend); a plan run_id
206	#   with a row of this batch is done; a trial without a row reruns into a fresh -r<k> run
207	#   dir (the stale dir is kept); counters and spend are recomputed from the rows.
208	#   --max-usd and --concurrency may change on resume; --clear-arm, --clear-drift and
209	#   --rerow need --resume (order: --clear-drift, --rerow and --rerun are checked before the lock,
210	#   then --rerow replaces rows, then the counters are recomputed with the rerun-flagged rows left
211	#   out of the done set; the reruns are dispatched with the plan). A resume clears STATUS.json
212	#   outage (kept under outage_history[]). A start
213	#   (fresh or resumed) is refused while a process group recorded under <batch>/.jobs/ by an
214	#   earlier driver (one killed with SIGKILL) is still alive.
215	#
216	# Exit: 0 complete (every trial rowed; none transport_error, infrastructure_error,
217	#       interrupted or contaminated), 1 partial (cut, the outage breaker, a paused arm with trials left, an
218	#       excluded row, or the driver was signalled), 2 usage or refused, 3 failed (drift, an
219	#       invalid or duplicated row, no trial completed without a cut, or every arm of the
220	#       plan paused)
221	#
222	# Env: LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_TREE, LOA_ABLATION_SOURCE_REPO, LOA_ABLATION_CACHE,
223	#   LOA_ABLATION_RETRY_WAIT_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S, LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S,
224	#   LOA_ABLATION_POLL_S (reap poll, default 1), LOA_ABLATION_OUTAGE_BREAKER (default 3),
225	#   EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN (host CLI).
226	# Library: lib/arms-common.sh beside this script, sourced by a literal relative path.
227	# Tested by evals/tests/run-ablation.bats (stub pipeline, grader and docker; no model call).
228	# =============================================================================

501	  python3 -I - "$1" "$MAN_PATH" "$2" <<'PY'
502	import glob, json, os, re, sys
503	rd, man, rid = sys.argv[1:4]
504	m = json.load(open(man)); p = json.load(open(os.path.join(rd, "meta", "pipeline.json")))
505	def norm(x):   # ablation-row.sh norm_model
506	    x = re.sub(r"^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.", "", str(x)); return re.sub(r"-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$", "", x)

508	extra, first = {}, None
509	def hit(field, exp, got):
510	    global first
511	    if first is None: first = {"run_id": rid, "field": field, "expected": exp, "got": got}
512	for ph in p.get("phases") or []:
513	    if not isinstance(ph, dict) or ph.get("skipped"): continue
514	    name, label = ph.get("name") or "", ph.get("label") or ph.get("name") or ""
515	    req = ph.get("model_requested")
516	    if name in pm and req is not None and norm(req) != norm(pm[name]):
517	        hit("model_requested." + label, pm[name], req)
518	    mu = ph.get("models_used") if isinstance(ph.get("models_used"), dict) else {}
519	    want = req if isinstance(req, str) and req else pm.get(name)
520	    if not mu or not want: continue
521	    if norm(want) not in {norm(k) for k in mu}:
522	        hit("models_used." + label, norm(pm.get(name) or want), sorted(mu))
523	        continue
524	    for k in sorted(mu):
525	        if norm(k) == norm(want): continue
526	        e = extra.setdefault(k, {"phases": [], "output_tokens": 0})
527	        e["phases"].append(label)
528	        v = mu[k]
529	        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool): e["output_tokens"] += int(v)
530	if first is None:
531	    want, seen = m.get("cli_version") or "", []
532	    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(rd, "transcripts", "events-*.jsonl"))):
533	        with open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
534	            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
535	                if n > 200: break
536	                if '"init"' not in line: continue
537	                try: e = json.loads(line)
538	                except ValueError: continue
539	                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("type") == "system" and e.get("subtype") == "init":
540	                    v = e.get("claude_code_version") or e.get("version")
541	                    if isinstance(v, str) and v: seen.append((os.path.basename(f), v))
542	                    break
543	    if seen and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", want):
544	        for f, v in seen:
545	            got = re.search(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", v)
546	            if (got.group(0) if got else v) != want: hit("cli_version", want, v); break

963	# post_run <run-dir> <run_id> <task> <task_yaml> <attempts> <retry_reason> <pipeline_status>
964	#          <override> <row-out> <log> — the chain after a finished pipeline, shared by a trial
965	# and by --rerow: took-effect, drift guard, grade (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs
966	# without an override), then ablation-row.sh into <row-out>. Results in PR_TE (ok | fail |
967	# skipped), PR_TE_REASON, PR_DRIFT (json or null), PR_EXTRA (the extra models, json),
968	# PR_GRC (null or the grade exit), PR_RRC (the row exit) and PR_OVERRIDE (the final override)
969	post_run() {
970	  local rd="$1" rid="$2" task="$3" tyaml="$4" attempts="$5" rr="$6" st="$7" row_out="$9" plog="${10}"
971	  PR_OVERRIDE="$8" PR_TE=skipped PR_TE_REASON="" PR_DRIFT=null PR_EXTRA='{}' PR_GRC=null PR_RRC=0
972	  if [[ -z "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]]; then
973	    case "$st" in
974	      completed|agent_error|cap_failure)
975	        local trc=0 tout dout id
976	        tout="$("$TOOK_BIN" --run-dir "$rd" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" 2>&1)" || trc=$?
977	        printf '%s\n' "$tout" >> "$plog"
978	        if [[ $trc -eq 0 ]]; then PR_TE=ok
979	        else
980	          PR_TE=fail PR_OVERRIDE=infrastructure_error
981	          PR_TE_REASON="took-effect exit $trc: $(grep -E ' FAIL' <<<"$tout" | head -4 | cut -c1-200 | tr '\n' ';' || true)"
982	        fi
983	        dout="$(drift_check "$rd" "$rid" 2>>"$plog" || true)"
984	        PR_DRIFT="$(sed -n 1p <<<"$dout")" PR_EXTRA="$(sed -n 2p <<<"$dout")"
985	        jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PR_DRIFT" || PR_DRIFT=null
986	        jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PR_EXTRA" || PR_EXTRA='{}'
987	        while IFS=$'\t' read -r id labels toks; do
988	          [[ -n "$id" ]] || continue
989	          printf 'run-ablation: extra model %s in %s (%s output tokens; a WebFetch summariser or built-in subagent, not drift — DEC-0545)\n' \
990	            "$id" "$labels" "$toks" >> "$plog"
991	        done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value.phases | join(",")), (.value.output_tokens | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$PR_EXTRA")
992	        if [[ "$PR_DRIFT" != null ]]; then PR_OVERRIDE=infrastructure_error; printf 'run-ablation: drift %s\n' "$PR_DRIFT" >> "$plog"; fi
993	        if [[ -z "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]]; then
994	          local -a g=("$GRADE_BIN" "$rd" "$task" --suite-root "$SUITE_ROOT" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE" --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN")
995	          [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && g+=(--tasks-dir smoke)
996	          PR_GRC=0; "${g[@]}" >> "$plog" 2>&1 || PR_GRC=$?
997	          if [[ $PR_GRC -ne 0 ]]; then PR_OVERRIDE=infrastructure_error; printf 'run-ablation: grade exit %s\n' "$PR_GRC" >> "$plog"; fi
998	        fi ;;
999	    esac
1000	  fi
1001	  local -a r=("$ROW_BIN" --run-dir "$rd" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --manifest "$MAN_PATH" --attempts "$attempts" --out "$row_out")
1002	  [[ -n "$rr" ]] && r+=(--retry-reason "$rr")
1003	  [[ -n "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]] && r+=(--status "$PR_OVERRIDE")
1004	  "${r[@]}" >> "$plog" 2>&1 || PR_RRC=$?
1005	  return 0
1006	}

1008	run_trial() {  # run_trial <jid> <arm> <task> <type> <kind> <trial> <run_id> <task_yaml> <watchdog_s>
1009	  local jid="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" type="$4" kind="$5" trial="$6" rid="$7" tyaml="$8" wds="$9"
1010	  local base="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
1011	  local attempt=0 rd="" st="" prc retry_reason="" first_usd=0 sig override="" pid
1012	  local t0 t1
1013	  mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
1014	  t0="$(date +%s)"
1015	  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
1016	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
1017	    rd="$(fresh_dir "$base")"
1018	    printf '%s\n' "$rd" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.rundir"
1019	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wdkill"
1020	    printf '%s run-ablation: %s attempt %d run_dir %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$attempt" "$rd" >> "$tlog"
1021	    local -a cmd=("$PIPELINE_BIN" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$rd" --run-id "$rid" --trial "$trial"
1022	                  --source-tree "$TREE" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE"
1023	                  --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN" --max-run-usd "$RUN_CAP")
1024	    # its own process group, so the watchdog can signal the pipeline and everything under it
1025	    if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
1026	    else "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
1027	    fi
1028	    pid=$!
1029	    printf '%s %s %s\n' "$pid" "$(date +%s)" "$wds" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
1030	    prc=0; wait "$pid" || prc=$?
1031	    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
1032	    st="$(final_status "$rd")"
1033	    if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" ]]; then
1034	      override=interrupted
1035	      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "watchdog: no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (pipeline exit $prc)"
1036	      break
1037	    fi
1038	    if [[ -z "$st" ]]; then
1039	      override=interrupted
1040	      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "no final pipeline record (pipeline exit $prc)"
1041	      break
1042	    fi
1043	    if [[ "$st" == agent_error ]] && sig="$(is_pipeline_transport_failure "$rd")"; then
1044	      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
1045	        first_usd="$(jq -r '(.spent_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
1046	        retry_reason="transport: ${sig% *} in phase ${sig#* }"
1047	        printf '%s run-ablation: %s %s; retrying once after %ss into a fresh run dir\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$retry_reason" "$RETRY_WAIT" >> "$tlog"
1048	        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
1049	      fi
1050	      override=transport_error
1051	    fi
1052	    break
1053	  done
1054	  post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "$tyaml" "$attempt" "$retry_reason" "$st" "$override" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$tlog"
1055	  t1="$(date +%s)"
1056	  jq -n --arg rid "$rid" --arg rd "$rd" --argjson att "$attempt" --arg rr "$retry_reason" --arg first "$first_usd" \
1057	    --arg pst "${st:-}" --arg ov "$PR_OVERRIDE" --arg te "$PR_TE" --arg ter "$PR_TE_REASON" --argjson drift "$PR_DRIFT" \
1058	    --argjson grc "$PR_GRC" --argjson rrc "$PR_RRC" --argjson secs "$(( t1 - t0 ))" --argjson extra "$PR_EXTRA" \
1059	    '{run_id: $rid, run_dir: $rd, attempts: $att, retry_reason: (if $rr == "" then null else $rr end),
1060	      first_attempt_usd: ($first | tonumber? // 0), pipeline_status: $pst, override: $ov, took_effect: $te,
1061	      took_effect_reason: $ter, drift: $drift, grade_rc: $grc, row_rc: $rrc, seconds: $secs,
1062	      extra_models: $extra}' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp"
1063	  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result"

1173	    f="$JOBS_DIR/$j.pgid"; [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
4	#
5	# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
6	# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
7	# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
8	# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
9	# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
10	# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
11	#
12	# Usage:
13	#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
14	#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
15	#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
16	#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
17	#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
18	#
19	# Options:
20	#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
21	#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
22	#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
23	#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
24	#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
25	#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
26	#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
27	#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
28	#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
29	#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
30	#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
31	#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
32	#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
33	#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
34	#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
35	#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
36	#                       at either path is refused)
37	#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
38	#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
39	#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other
40	#                       arms are present
41	#   --resamples N       default rules.bootstrap.resamples (10,000); a value other than the
42	#                       pre-registered one is marked in the header
43	#   --level L           default rules.bootstrap.level (0.90); same marking
44	#   --exclude-degraded  true (default) | false: rows with degraded: true are excluded
45	#                       pairwise (rules.exclusion.statuses names `degraded`)
46	#   --partial           prints "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"; exit 1 when no
47	#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
48	#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
49	#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut
50	#                       (default) or inconclusive_by_power (a pre-declared power cut)
51	#   --not-run CSV       arm ids or labels read as Not run (cut) with figure "--not-run"
52	#
53	# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
54	#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
55	#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
56	#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
57	#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
58	#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
59	#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
60	#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
61	#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
62	#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
63	#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
64	#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
65	#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
66	#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
67	#
68	# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
69	#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
70	#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
71	#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
72	#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
73	#                   ids when present, else each defect of the task takes the row's
74	#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows); the task-level figure is also
75	#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
76	#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
77	#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
78	#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
79	#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
80	#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
81	#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
82	#                   cells the primaries paired
83	#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
84	#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
85	#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
86	#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
87	#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
88	#
89	# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
90	#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
91	#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
92	#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
93	#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an
94	#   applicable primary exceeds rules.mde_cut and whose predicate outcome is remove or
95	#   simplify reads Inconclusive-by-power with the figure (a null result the sample could
96	#   not have detected); A8 (absent: true) reads component-absent with the suite evidence.
97	#
98	# Exit codes:
99	#   0  report written
100	#   1  --partial and no decidable comparison (the report is still written)
101	#   2  usage error, unreadable input, unknown schema major, provenance conflict
102	#
103	# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-report.bats (planted rows generated by
104	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py).

168	def schema_major(v):
169	    if isinstance(v, bool):
170	        return None
171	    if isinstance(v, int):
172	        return v
173	    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():

180	def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
181	    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
182	    n = len(sorted_xs)
183	    if n == 0:
184	        return None
185	    pos = q * (n - 1)
186	    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
187	    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
188	    frac = pos - lo
189	    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac

192	def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
193	    if not diffs:
194	        return None, None
195	    rng = random.Random(seed)
196	    n = len(diffs)
197	    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
198	    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
199	    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)
200

202	def mde(diffs, level):
203	    if len(diffs) < 2:
204	        return None
205	    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
206	    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
207	    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

210	def collapse(run_ids):
211	    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
212	    groups, other = {}, []
213	    for rid in run_ids:
214	        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
215	        if m:
216	            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
217	        else:
218	            other.append(rid)
219	    out = []
220	    for prefix in sorted(groups):
221	        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
222	        if len(ns) == 1:
223	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
224	        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
225	            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
226	        else:
227	            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
228	    return out + sorted(other)

236	def load_suite(path):
237	    try:
238	        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
239	            raw = fh.read()
240	    except OSError as e:
241	        raise Fail(f"cannot read suite {path}: {e.strerror}")
242	    try:
243	        suite = json.loads(raw)
244	    except ValueError:
245	        try:
246	            out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
247	            suite = json.loads(out)
248	        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
249	            raise Fail(f"cannot parse suite {path} (YAML needs yq v4 on PATH)")
250	    if not isinstance(suite, dict) or not isinstance(suite.get("arms"), list) or not isinstance(suite.get("rules"), dict):
251	        raise Fail(f"suite {path} has no arms[] or rules block")
252	    lines, inside = [], False
253	    for line in raw.splitlines():
254	        if re.match(r"^rules:", line):
255	            inside = True
256	        elif inside and line.strip() and not line[0].isspace() and not line.startswith("#"):
257	            break
258	        if inside:
259	            lines.append(line)
260	    while lines and not lines[-1].strip():
261	        lines.pop()
262	    rules_text = "\n".join(lines) if lines else json.dumps({"rules": suite["rules"]}, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
263	    return suite, rules_text

266	def load_rows(paths):
267	    rows, dup = [], []
268	    seen = {}
269	    for path in paths:
270	        try:
271	            fh = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
272	        except OSError as e:
273	            raise Fail(f"cannot read --runs {path}: {e.strerror}")
274	        with fh:
275	            for n, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
276	                if not line.strip():
277	                    continue
278	                where = f"{path}:{n}"
279	                try:
280	                    row = json.loads(line)
281	                except ValueError:
282	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: line is not valid JSON")
283	                if not isinstance(row, dict):
284	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row is not a JSON object")
285	                rid = row.get("run_id")
286	                if "schema_version" not in row:
287	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has no schema_version (1 required)")
288	                major = schema_major(row.get("schema_version"))
289	                if major != ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR:
290	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has schema_version {row.get('schema_version')!r}; "
291	                               f"this reader knows major {ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR} only")
292	                for k, ty in (("run_id", str), ("batch", str), ("arm", str), ("task_id", str),
293	                              ("task_type", str), ("status", str)):
294	                    if not isinstance(row.get(k), ty) or not row.get(k):
295	                        raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has no {k}")
296	                if isinstance(row.get("trial"), bool) or not isinstance(row.get("trial"), int):
297	                    raise Fail(f"{where}: row {rid} has no integer trial")
298	                row = dict(row)
299	                row["_where"] = where
300	                if rid in seen:
301	                    dup.append({"run_id": rid, "kept": where, "dropped": seen[rid]["_where"]})
302	                    rows.remove(seen[rid])
303	                seen[rid] = row
304	                rows.append(row)
305	    return rows, dup

376	# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the analysis
377	class Analysis:
378	    def __init__(self, suite, rows, mans, args, cap_excluded):
379	        self.suite, self.rules, self.args = suite, suite["rules"], args
380	        self.cap_excluded = cap_excluded
381	        self.arms = {a["id"]: a for a in suite["arms"] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")}
382	        ex = self.rules.get("exclusion") or {}
383	        self.ex_statuses = set(ex.get("statuses") or []) | set(DEC0417_EXCLUDED)
384	        self.guard = float(ex.get("inconclusive_above_share", 0.25))
385	        self.listed = []        # rows that never enter a decision, with the reason
386	        self.excluded = []      # excluded rows (status/reason), superseded included
387	        self.cells = {}         # (arm, task) -> {trial: {"valid": row|None, "rows": [...]}}
388	        self.task_type = {}
389	        self.task_defects = {}
390	        self.arm_rows = {}
391	        for row in rows:
392	            seeded = row.get("defects_seeded")
393	            if isinstance(seeded, int) and not isinstance(seeded, bool) and seeded > 0:
394	                self.task_defects[row["task_id"]] = max(self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0), seeded)
395	        for row in rows:
396	            self._classify(row, mans)
397	        for (arm, task), trials in self.cells.items():
398	            for t, cell in trials.items():
399	                valid = [x for x in cell["rows"] if x["_valid"]]
400	                cell["valid"] = valid[-1] if valid else None
401	                for x in cell["rows"]:
402	                    if x["_valid"] and x is not cell["valid"]:
403	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, f"duplicate cell; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}",
404	                                                         counted=False))
405	                    elif not x["_valid"]:
406	                        sup = f"; superseded by {cell['valid']['run_id']}" if cell["valid"] else ""
407	                        self.excluded.append(self._exrow(x, x["_reason"] + sup, counted=not cell["valid"]))
408	
409	    @staticmethod
410	    def _exrow(x, reason, counted):
411	        return {"run_id": x["run_id"], "arm": x["arm"], "task_id": x["task_id"], "trial": x["trial"],
412	                "status": x["status"], "reason": reason, "cell_excluded": counted}
413	
414	    def applies(self, arm, ttype):
415	        types = self.arms[arm].get("task_types") or []
416	        return "all" in types or ttype in types or ("build" in types and ttype in BUILD_TYPES)
417	
418	    def primaries(self, arm):
419	        types = self.arms[arm].get("task_types") or []
420	        pba = self.rules.get("primaries_by_arm") or {}
421	        if "all" in types or REVIEW in types:
422	            return list(pba.get("all_types") or [PASS, CATCH])
423	        return list(pba.get("build_only") or [PASS])
424	
425	    def _classify(self, row, mans):
426	        arm, task, ttype = row["arm"], row["task_id"], row["task_type"]
427	        m = mans.get(row["batch"])
428	        if m is None:
429	            return self.listed.append((row, "no manifest for batch " + row["batch"]))
430	        amap = m.get("arm_map") or {}
431	        if isinstance(amap, dict) and row["run_id"] in amap and amap[row["run_id"]] != arm:
432	            raise Fail(f"{row['_where']}: row {row['run_id']} arm {arm} disagrees with "
433	                       f"{m['_path']} arm_map ({amap[row['run_id']]})")
434	        if m.get("smoke") is True:
435	            return self.listed.append((row, "smoke batch " + row["batch"]))
436	        if arm not in self.arms or self.arms[arm].get("absent"):
437	            return self.listed.append((row, f"arm {arm} is not run by the suite"))
438	        if ttype not in BUILD_TYPES and ttype != REVIEW:
439	            return self.listed.append((row, f"unknown task_type {ttype}"))
440	        if not self.applies(arm, ttype):
441	            return self.listed.append((row, f"not applicable: {arm} does not run {ttype} tasks"))
442	        self.task_type[task] = ttype
443	        self.arm_rows.setdefault(arm, []).append(row)
444	        st = row["status"]
445	        reason = None
446	        if st in self.ex_statuses:
447	            reason = st
448	        elif self.args.exclude_degraded and row.get("degraded") is True:
449	            reason = "degraded: " + str(row.get("degraded_reason") or "no reason recorded")
450	        elif st not in SCORING:
451	            reason = "status " + st
452	        elif st == "cap_failure" and self.cap_excluded:
453	            reason = "cap_failure (sensitivity figure)"
454	        elif st != "cap_failure":
455	            if ttype == REVIEW and not isinstance(row.get(CATCH), (int, float)):
456	                reason = "ungraded (defect_catch_rate null)"
457	            elif ttype != REVIEW and not isinstance(row.get(PASS), (int, float)):
458	                reason = "ungraded (hidden_test_pass_rate null)"
459	        row["_valid"] = reason is None
460	        row["_reason"] = reason
461	        cell = self.cells.setdefault((arm, task), {}).setdefault(row["trial"], {"valid": None, "rows": []})
462	        cell["rows"].append(row)
463	
464	    # -- scores
465	    def pass_score(self, row):
466	        return 0.0 if row["status"] == "cap_failure" else float(row[PASS])
467	
468	    def catch_task_score(self, row):
469	        return 0.0 if row["status"] == "cap_failure" else float(row[CATCH])
470	
471	    def defect_vector(self, row):
472	        n = self.task_defects.get(row["task_id"], 0)
473	        if n <= 0:
474	            return None, "none"
475	        if row["status"] == "cap_failure":
476	            return [0.0] * n, "cap"
477	        missed = row.get("defects_missed")
478	        if missed is None and isinstance(row.get("recall"), dict):
479	            missed = row["recall"].get("missed")
480	        if isinstance(missed, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in missed):
481	            ms = set(missed)
482	            return [0.0 if f"d{k}" in ms else 1.0 for k in range(1, n + 1)], "ids"
483	        return [float(row[CATCH])] * n, "rate"
484	
485	    # -- shares
486	    def excluded_share(self, arm):
487	        cells = [c for (a, _), trials in self.cells.items() if a == arm for c in trials.values()]
488	        if not cells:
489	            return None, 0, 0
490	        ex = sum(1 for c in cells if c["valid"] is None)
491	        return ex / len(cells), ex, len(cells)
492	
493	    # -- one paired comparison of `arm` against `ctrl` on one primary
494	    def compare(self, arm, ctrl, metric, seed):
495	        types = (REVIEW,) if metric == CATCH else BUILD_TYPES
496	        tasks = sorted({t for (a, t) in self.cells if a in (arm, ctrl) and self.task_type.get(t) in types})
497	        res = {"metric": metric, "arm": arm, "control": ctrl, "unit": "tasks", "pairs": [], "unpaired": [],
498	               "dropped": [], "diffs": [], "task_diffs": [], "defect_identity": set()}
499	        for task in tasks:
500	            ca, cc = self.cells.get((arm, task), {}), self.cells.get((ctrl, task), {})
501	            drop = sorted(t for t in set(ca) | set(cc)
502	                          if (t in ca and ca[t]["valid"] is None) or (t in cc and cc[t]["valid"] is None))
503	            for t in drop:
504	                for side, cs in ((arm, ca), (ctrl, cc)):
505	                    if t in cs and cs[t]["valid"] is not None:
506	                        res["dropped"].append({"task_id": task, "trial": t, "arm": side,
507	                                               "run_id": cs[t]["valid"]["run_id"]})
508	            va = [ca[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(ca) if t not in drop]
509	            vc = [cc[t]["valid"] for t in sorted(cc) if t not in drop]
510	            if not va or not vc:
511	                why = []
512	                for side, cs, vs in ((arm, ca, va), (ctrl, cc, vc)):
513	                    if vs:
514	                        continue
515	                    if not cs:
516	                        why.append(f"no row in {side}")
517	                    elif all(cs[t]["valid"] is None for t in cs):
518	                        why.append(f"every cell of {side} excluded")
519	                    else:
520	                        why.append(f"the cells of {side} dropped pairwise")
521	                res["unpaired"].append({"task_id": task, "reason": "; ".join(why)})
522	                continue
523	            pair = {"task_id": task, "arm_runs": [r["run_id"] for r in va], "control_runs": [r["run_id"] for r in vc],
524	                    "arm_cost": mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in va]),
525	                    "control_cost": mean([float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0) for r in vc]),
526	                    "arm_wall": mean([float(r.get("wall_clock_ms") or 0) for r in va]),
527	                    "control_wall": mean([float(r.get("wall_clock_ms") or 0) for r in vc])}
528	            if metric == PASS:
529	                ma, mc = mean([self.pass_score(r) for r in va]), mean([self.pass_score(r) for r in vc])
530	                pair.update(arm_value=ma, control_value=mc, diff=ma - mc)
531	                res["diffs"].append(ma - mc)
532	                res["task_diffs"].append(ma - mc)
533	            else:
534	                ma, mc = mean([self.catch_task_score(r) for r in va]), mean([self.catch_task_score(r) for r in vc])
535	                pair.update(arm_value=ma, control_value=mc, diff=ma - mc)
536	                res["task_diffs"].append(ma - mc)
537	                vecs_a = [self.defect_vector(r) for r in va]
538	                vecs_c = [self.defect_vector(r) for r in vc]
539	                for _, how in vecs_a + vecs_c:
540	                    res["defect_identity"].add(how)
541	                if all(v is not None for v, _ in vecs_a + vecs_c):
542	                    n = len(vecs_a[0][0])
543	                    dd = [mean([v[k] for v, _ in vecs_a]) - mean([v[k] for v, _ in vecs_c]) for k in range(n)]
544	                    pair["defects"] = n
545	                    pair["defect_diffs"] = dd
546	                    res["diffs"].extend(dd)
547	                else:
548	                    pair["defects"] = 0
549	            res["pairs"].append(pair)
550	        if metric == CATCH:
551	            res["unit"] = "defects"
552	        res["defect_identity"] = sorted(res["defect_identity"] - {"cap"})
553	        n = len(res["diffs"])
554	        res["n"] = n
555	        res["n_tasks"] = len(res["pairs"])
556	        res["d"] = mean(res["diffs"]) if n else None
557	        res["lo"], res["hi"] = bootstrap(res["diffs"], self.args.resamples, self.args.level, seed)
558	        res["mde"] = mde(res["diffs"], self.args.level)
559	        res["half_width"] = None if res["lo"] is None else (res["hi"] - res["lo"]) / 2.0
560	        if metric == CATCH:
561	            td = res["task_diffs"]
562	            lo, hi = bootstrap(td, self.args.resamples, self.args.level, seed)
563	            res["task_level"] = {"unit": "tasks", "n": len(td), "d": mean(td) if td else None, "lo": lo, "hi": hi}

566	    def deltas(self, comps):
567	        """c and w over the per-task means of the cells the primaries paired."""
568	        per_task = {}
569	        for comp in comps:
570	            for p in comp["pairs"]:
571	                per_task.setdefault(p["task_id"], p)
572	        if not per_task:
573	            return None, None, 0
574	        ps = [per_task[t] for t in sorted(per_task)]
575	
576	        def delta(a, c):
577	            ma, mc = mean([p[a] for p in ps]), mean([p[c] for p in ps])
578	            return None if not mc else (ma - mc) / mc * 100.0
579	
580	        return delta("arm_cost", "control_cost"), delta("arm_wall", "control_wall"), len(ps)

582	    def decide(self, arm, comps, c, w, share):
583	        T = float(self.rules.get("threshold_points", 0.03))
584	        C = float(self.rules.get("cost_lower_pct", 15))
585	        P = [p for p in comps if p["n"] > 0]
586	        nopair = len(P) < len(comps)
587	        name = lambda p: p["metric"]  # noqa: E731
588	        if share is not None and r9(share) > self.guard:
589	            # DEC-0393: the degradation guard reads first, whatever the interval (lead's ruling, Sprint 260)
590	            clause = f"excluded share {share:.3f} > {self.guard:g}"
591	            return "inconclusive", f"inconclusive (degradation guard, evaluated first): {clause}", [clause]
592	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["lo"]) > 0]
593	        if hits:
594	            return "investigate", f"investigate: any applicable primary has lo > 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
595	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T and r9(p["hi"]) < 0]
596	        if hits:
597	            return "keep", f"keep: any applicable primary has d < -{T:g} and hi < 0 ({', '.join(hits)})", []
598	        clauses = []
599	        hits = [name(p) for p in P if r9(p["d"]) < -T]
600	        if hits:
601	            clauses.append(f"d < -{T:g} ({', '.join(hits)})")
602	        if nopair:
603	            clauses.append("no valid pair (" + ", ".join(name(p) for p in comps if p["n"] == 0) + ")")
604	        if clauses:
605	            return "inconclusive", "inconclusive: " + "; ".join(clauses), clauses
606	        cost_ok = (c is not None and r9(c) <= -C) or (w is not None and r9(w) <= -C)
607	        if all(r9(p["d"]) >= -T for p in comps) and cost_ok:
608	            which = []
609	            if c is not None and r9(c) <= -C:
610	                which.append(f"c = {c:+.1f}")
611	            if w is not None and r9(w) <= -C:
612	                which.append(f"w = {w:+.1f}")
613	            return "remove", (f"remove: every applicable primary has d >= -{T:g} and "
614	                              f"(c <= -{C:g} or w <= -{C:g}) ({', '.join(which)})"), []
615	        return "simplify", f"simplify: every applicable primary within -{T:g}, cost similar", []

617	    def arm_report(self, arm, cuts, seed):
618	        prims = self.primaries(arm)
619	        comps = [self.compare(arm, CONTROL, m, seed) for m in prims]
620	        c, w, n_cost = self.deltas(comps)
621	        share, ex, seen = self.excluded_share(arm)
622	        out = {"arm": arm, "arm_label": self.arms[arm].get("label", arm), "primaries": prims,
623	               "comparisons": comps, "c": c, "w": w, "cost_tasks": n_cost,
624	               "excluded_share": share, "excluded_cells": ex, "cells_seen": seen}
625	        if not seen:
626	            state, rule, clauses = "no_rows", "no rows for this arm", []
627	        else:
628	            state, rule, clauses = self.decide(arm, comps, c, w, share)
629	        out["predicate_state"] = state
630	        out["predicate_rule"] = rule
631	        label = DISPLAY.get(state, state)
632	        if state == "inconclusive" and any(cl.startswith("excluded share") for cl in clauses):
633	            label = "Inconclusive-by-degradation"
634	        out["predicate_label"] = label
635	        figure = None
636	        mde_cut = self.rules.get("mde_cut")
637	        over = [p for p in comps if p["mde"] is not None and mde_cut is not None and r9(p["mde"]) > float(mde_cut)]
638	        if arm in cuts:
639	            cut = cuts[arm]
640	            state, label = cut["state"], DISPLAY[cut["state"]]
641	            rule = f"{cut['source']}: {cut['reason']}".rstrip(": ")
642	            figure = cut["figure"]
643	        elif state in ("remove", "simplify") and over:
644	            figure = "; ".join(f"MDE {p['mde']:.3f} > {float(mde_cut):g} on {p['metric']} (n = {p['n']} {p['unit']})"
645	                               for p in over)
646	            rule = f"inconclusive_by_power: {figure} (predicate read {DISPLAY[out['predicate_state']]})"
647	            state, label = "inconclusive_by_power", DISPLAY["inconclusive_by_power"]
648	        out.update(state=state, label=label, rule=rule, figure=figure,
649	                   mde_flag=[p["metric"] for p in over])
650	        out["decidable"] = bool(seen) and all(p["n"] > 0 for p in comps)
651	        return out

653	    def arm_metrics(self, arm):
654	        """Unpaired per-arm figures (AC-8.2): task-mean of trial means and the secondaries."""
655	        rows = self.arm_rows.get(arm, [])
656	        valid = [c["valid"] for (a, _), trials in sorted(self.cells.items()) if a == arm
657	                 for _, c in sorted(trials.items()) if c["valid"] is not None]
658	        by_task = {}
659	        for r in valid:
660	            by_task.setdefault(r["task_id"], []).append(r)
661	        status = {}
662	        for r in rows:
663	            status[r["status"]] = status.get(r["status"], 0) + 1
664	
665	        def task_mean(rs_by_task, f):
666	            return mean([mean([f(r) for r in rs]) for rs in rs_by_task.values()])
667	
668	        build = {t: rs for t, rs in by_task.items() if self.task_type[t] in BUILD_TYPES}
669	        rc = {t: rs for t, rs in by_task.items() if self.task_type[t] == REVIEW}
670	
671	        def bools(key):
672	            vs = [r.get(key) for r in valid if isinstance(r.get(key), bool)]
673	            return None if not vs else sum(1 for v in vs if v) / len(vs)
674	
675	        def nums(key, rs=None):
676	            vs = [r.get(key) for r in (valid if rs is None else rs)
677	                  if isinstance(r.get(key), (int, float)) and not isinstance(r.get(key), bool)]
678	            return mean(vs)
679	
680	        return {
681	            "rows": len(rows), "by_status": dict(sorted(status.items())),
682	            "degraded_rows": sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("degraded") is True),
683	            "valid_cells": len(valid),
684	            PASS: task_mean(build, self.pass_score) if build else None,
685	            CATCH: task_mean(rc, self.catch_task_score) if rc else None,
686	            "verdict_accuracy": bools("verdict_accuracy"),
687	            "verdict_accuracy_review": bools("verdict_accuracy_review"),
688	            "verdict_accuracy_audit": bools("verdict_accuracy_audit"),
689	            "false_positives_per_task": {t: nums("false_positives", rs) for t, rs in sorted(rc.items())},
690	            "regressions_per_run": nums("regressions"),
691	            "diff_lines_per_run": nums("diff_lines"), "files_changed_per_run": nums("files_changed"),
692	            "cost_per_task": task_mean(by_task, lambda r: float(r.get("cost_usd") or 0)) if by_task else None,
693	            "cost_per_run": nums("cost_usd"),
694	            "wall_clock_ms_per_run": nums("wall_clock_ms"),
695	            "tokens_in_per_run": nums("tokens_in"), "tokens_out_per_run": nums("tokens_out"),
696	        }

# drift_check <run-dir> <run_id> → two lines: the drift {run_id, field, expected, got} or null,
# then the extra models {<raw id>: {phases: [<label>…], output_tokens: N}} ({} when none).
# Read-only on the run dir. A phase drifts on model grounds only when its model_requested
# differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the requested model (else the manifest's)
# is absent from a non-empty models_used; any other models_used key is an extra model (a
# WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent: telemetry, DEC-0545)
drift_check() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$MAN_PATH" "$2" <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, re, sys
rd, man, rid = sys.argv[1:4]
m = json.load(open(man)); p = json.load(open(os.path.join(rd, "meta", "pipeline.json")))
def norm(x):   # ablation-row.sh norm_model
    x = re.sub(r"^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.", "", str(x)); return re.sub(r"-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$", "", x)
pm = m.get("phase_models") or {}
extra, first = {}, None
def hit(field, exp, got):
    global first
    if first is None: first = {"run_id": rid, "field": field, "expected": exp, "got": got}
for ph in p.get("phases") or []:
    if not isinstance(ph, dict) or ph.get("skipped"): continue
    name, label = ph.get("name") or "", ph.get("label") or ph.get("name") or ""
    req = ph.get("model_requested")
    if name in pm and req is not None and norm(req) != norm(pm[name]):
        hit("model_requested." + label, pm[name], req)
    mu = ph.get("models_used") if isinstance(ph.get("models_used"), dict) else {}
    want = req if isinstance(req, str) and req else pm.get(name)
    if not mu or not want: continue
    if norm(want) not in {norm(k) for k in mu}:
        hit("models_used." + label, norm(pm.get(name) or want), sorted(mu))
        continue
    for k in sorted(mu):
        if norm(k) == norm(want): continue
        e = extra.setdefault(k, {"phases": [], "output_tokens": 0})
        e["phases"].append(label)
        v = mu[k]
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool): e["output_tokens"] += int(v)
if first is None:
    want, seen = m.get("cli_version") or "", []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(rd, "transcripts", "events-*.jsonl"))):
        with open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
                if n > 200: break
                if '"init"' not in line: continue
                try: e = json.loads(line)
                except ValueError: continue
                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("type") == "system" and e.get("subtype") == "init":
                    v = e.get("claude_code_version") or e.get("version")
                    if isinstance(v, str) and v: seen.append((os.path.basename(f), v))
                    break
    if seen and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", want):
        for f, v in seen:
            got = re.search(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", v)
            if (got.group(0) if got else v) != want: hit("cli_version", want, v); break
    elif not seen and m.get("image_digest") and p.get("image_digest") and m["image_digest"] != p["image_digest"]:
        hit("image_digest", m["image_digest"], p["image_digest"])
print(json.dumps(first) if first is not None else "null")
print(json.dumps(extra, sort_keys=True))
PY
}

  usd_ok "${RUN_CAP:-x}" || RUN_CAP="$(jq -r '.caps.run_usd // ""' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  usd_ok "${RUN_CAP:-x}" || RUN_CAP=12
fi
hint_for() { local h; h="$(jq -r --arg k "$1" '.cost_hint | if type == "object" then .[$k] // "" else (. // "") end' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"; usd_ok "${h:-x}" || h=5.0; printf '%s' "$h"; }
HINT_BUILD="$(hint_for build)" HINT_REVIEW="$(hint_for review-catch)"
# est_next's last fallback per kind (the key is "<arm>|<kind>")
est_hint() { if [[ "${1#*|}" == review-catch ]]; then printf '%s' "$HINT_REVIEW"; else printf '%s' "$HINT_BUILD"; fi; }

# --- arms and tasks -----------------------------------------------------------------------
[[ -n "$ARMS_CSV" ]] || ARMS_CSV="$(jq -r '(.arms // [] | map(select(.absent == true) | .id)) as $absent
                                            | [.priority // [] | .[] | select(IN($absent[]) | not)] | join(",")' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
IFS=',' read -r -a ARMS <<<"$ARMS_CSV"
[[ ${#ARMS[@]} -gt 0 && -n "${ARMS[0]}" ]] || die "no arms (--arms, or the suite's priority)"
for a in "${ARMS[@]}"; do
  [[ "$a" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid arm id '$a'"
  def="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
  [[ -n "$def" ]] || die "arm '$a' is not declared in $SUITE_FILE"
  [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$def")" != true ]] || die "arm '$a' is declared absent: true"
done
[[ "$(printf '%s\n' "${ARMS[@]}" | sort | uniq -d)" == "" ]] || die "--arms lists an arm twice"

ALL_TASKS=()
while IFS= read -r d; do ALL_TASKS+=("$d"); done < <(cd "$TDIR" && for d in */; do d="${d%/}"; [[ -f "$d/task.yaml" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$d"; done | LC_ALL=C sort)
[[ ${#ALL_TASKS[@]} -gt 0 ]] || die "no tasks under $TDIR"
SEL_TASKS=()
if [[ -n "$TASKS_CSV" && "$RESUME" != true ]]; then
  IFS=',' read -r -a SEL_TASKS <<<"$TASKS_CSV"
  for t in "${SEL_TASKS[@]}"; do
    [[ "$t" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,63}$ ]] || die "invalid task id '$t'"
    [[ -f "$TDIR/$t/task.yaml" ]] || die "task not found: $TDIR/$t/task.yaml"
  done
else
  SEL_TASKS=("${ALL_TASKS[@]}")
fi
WANT_TYPES=""
if [[ -n "$TYPES_CSV" ]]; then
  IFS=',' read -r -a tl <<<"$TYPES_CSV"
  for ty in "${tl[@]}"; do
    case "$ty" in
      build) WANT_TYPES="$WANT_TYPES feature-build bug-fix refactor" ;;
      feature-build|bug-fix|refactor|review-catch) WANT_TYPES="$WANT_TYPES $ty" ;;
      *) die "invalid --types entry '$ty'" ;;
    esac
  done
fi

WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/run-ablation.XXXXXX")"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' "$SUITE_JSON" > "$WORK/suite.json"
for t in "${SEL_TASKS[@]}"; do
  yq -o=json '{"id": .id, "type": .type, "bounds": (.bounds // {})}' "$TDIR/$t/task.yaml" \
    | jq -c --arg y "$TDIR/$t/task.yaml" --arg want "$WANT_TYPES" \
        'select($want == "" or (($want | split(" ")) | index(.type)) != null) | with_entries(.) + {yaml: $y}'
done | jq -s -c '.' > "$WORK/tasks.json" || die "a task.yaml does not parse"
[[ "$(jq 'length' "$WORK/tasks.json")" -gt 0 ]] || die "no task left after --tasks/--types"
jq -e 'all(.[]; (.type == "feature-build" or .type == "bug-fix" or .type == "refactor" or .type == "review-catch"))' \
  "$WORK/tasks.json" >/dev/null || die "a task has an unknown type"
TB="${TRIALS_BUILD:-}" TR="${TRIALS_REVIEW:-}"
if [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]]; then TB="${TB:-1}" TR="${TR:-1}"; fi
[[ -n "$TB" ]] || TB="$(jq -r '.trials.build // 3' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
[[ -n "$TR" ]] || TR="$(jq -r '.trials["review-catch"] // 3' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
[[ "$TB" =~ ^[1-9]$ && "$TR" =~ ^[1-9]$ ]] || die "suite trials must be 1-9"

# --- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sha_file() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
semver_of() { grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' <<<"$1" | head -1 || true; }
# drift_check <run-dir> <run_id> → two lines: the drift {run_id, field, expected, got} or null,
# then the extra models {<raw id>: {phases: [<label>…], output_tokens: N}} ({} when none).
# Read-only on the run dir. A phase drifts on model grounds only when its model_requested
# differs from MANIFEST phase_models[name], or when the requested model (else the manifest's)
# is absent from a non-empty models_used; any other models_used key is an extra model (a
# WebFetch summariser or a built-in subagent: telemetry, DEC-0545)
drift_check() {
  python3 -I - "$1" "$MAN_PATH" "$2" <<'PY'
import glob, json, os, re, sys
rd, man, rid = sys.argv[1:4]
m = json.load(open(man)); p = json.load(open(os.path.join(rd, "meta", "pipeline.json")))
def norm(x):   # ablation-row.sh norm_model
    x = re.sub(r"^([a-z]+\.)?anthropic\.", "", str(x)); return re.sub(r"-v[0-9]+(:[0-9]+)?$", "", x)
pm = m.get("phase_models") or {}
extra, first = {}, None
def hit(field, exp, got):
    global first
    if first is None: first = {"run_id": rid, "field": field, "expected": exp, "got": got}
for ph in p.get("phases") or []:
    if not isinstance(ph, dict) or ph.get("skipped"): continue
    name, label = ph.get("name") or "", ph.get("label") or ph.get("name") or ""
    req = ph.get("model_requested")
    if name in pm and req is not None and norm(req) != norm(pm[name]):
        hit("model_requested." + label, pm[name], req)
    mu = ph.get("models_used") if isinstance(ph.get("models_used"), dict) else {}
    want = req if isinstance(req, str) and req else pm.get(name)
    if not mu or not want: continue
    if norm(want) not in {norm(k) for k in mu}:
        hit("models_used." + label, norm(pm.get(name) or want), sorted(mu))
        continue
    for k in sorted(mu):
        if norm(k) == norm(want): continue
        e = extra.setdefault(k, {"phases": [], "output_tokens": 0})
        e["phases"].append(label)
        v = mu[k]
        if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool): e["output_tokens"] += int(v)
if first is None:
    want, seen = m.get("cli_version") or "", []
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(rd, "transcripts", "events-*.jsonl"))):
        with open(f, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
            for n, line in enumerate(fh):
                if n > 200: break
                if '"init"' not in line: continue
                try: e = json.loads(line)
                except ValueError: continue
                if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("type") == "system" and e.get("subtype") == "init":
                    v = e.get("claude_code_version") or e.get("version")
                    if isinstance(v, str) and v: seen.append((os.path.basename(f), v))
                    break
    if seen and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", want):
        for f, v in seen:
            got = re.search(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", v)
            if (got.group(0) if got else v) != want: hit("cli_version", want, v); break
    elif not seen and m.get("image_digest") and p.get("image_digest") and m["image_digest"] != p["image_digest"]:
        hit("image_digest", m["image_digest"], p["image_digest"])
print(json.dumps(first) if first is not None else "null")
print(json.dumps(extra, sort_keys=True))
PY
}
LOG=""
log() { local l; l="$(date -u +%H:%M:%SZ) $*"; printf '%s\n' "$l" >&2; [[ -z "$LOG" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$l" >> "$LOG"; }

# --- pre-flight ----------------------------------------------------------------------
GATE_JSON=null
if [[ "$SMOKE" != true ]]; then
  [[ -f "$SUITE_ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): $SUITE_ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256 is missing (freeze the suite first)"
  [[ -f "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log $SELF_CHECK_LOG is missing"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ablation-grade.sh — the cycle-130 ablation grader (SDD §3.6, §5.7, D-4.7, D-4.8;
4	# PRD FR-6 AC-6.1/6.2/6.4; DEC-0401, DEC-0413, DEC-0414, DEC-0420, DEC-0491, DEC-0493)
5	#
6	# Grades ONE run directory written by pipeline-run.sh against its task and writes
7	# grade.json (the input ablation-row.sh joins into the runs.jsonl row), or
8	# self-checks a task (--self-check) on a synthetic run built from the task itself.
9	#
10	# Usage:
11	#   ablation-grade.sh <run-dir> <task-id> [--suite-root DIR] [--tasks-dir tasks|smoke]
12	#                     [--out FILE] [--json] [--executor container|host]
13	#                     [--image loa-ablation:258] [--docker-bin D]
14	#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
15	#   ablation-grade.sh --self-check base|reference|noisy --task-yaml F [--suite-root DIR]
16	#                     [--executor …] [--image …] [--docker-bin D] [--json]
17	#                     [--allow-unfrozen] [--allow-partial]
18	#
19	# Options:
20	#   --suite-root DIR   suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0; with
21	#                      --self-check, the directory two levels above the task dir)
22	#   --tasks-dir T      tasks (default) or smoke: the task is <root>/<T>/<task-id>/
23	#   --out FILE         where grade.json goes (default <run-dir>/grade.json)
24	#   --json             also print grade.json (self-check: the verdict object) on stdout
25	#   --executor MODE    container (default; DEC-0491) or host. host runs the agent's code on
26	#                      this machine as the calling user without isolation and is refused
27	#                      (exit 2) unless LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1; allowed, it prints a
28	#                      WARNING and grade.json records executor_mode: host (LOW-A1)
29	#   --image IMG        the grading image (default loa-ablation:258)
30	#   --docker-bin D     docker CLI (default $EVAL_DOCKER_BIN, else docker)
31	#   --allow-unfrozen   grade although freeze.sh --check fails or the suite has no
32	#                      MANIFEST.sha256 yet (task authoring only); grade.json records
33	#                      suite_frozen: false. Without it a drift is exit 2 (DEC-0414).
34	#   --allow-partial    passed to freeze.sh --check (fewer than four tasks per type)
35	#   --self-check MODE  base | reference | noisy (noisy: review-catch only), see below
36	#   --task-yaml F      the task to self-check (<root>/<tasks|smoke>/<id>/task.yaml)
37	#
38	# Environment: LOA_EVAL_ALLOW_HOST_GRADING=1 (see --executor); LOA_EVAL_GRADE_TIMEOUT_S
39	# (1-9999, default 120: the per-command deadline; tests shorten it).
40	#
41	# Reads ONLY (DEC-0413): <run-dir>/sandbox/, <run-dir>/snapshots/{index.json,<LABEL>.bundle},
42	# <run-dir>/transcripts/events-*.jsonl, <run-dir>/eval/adversarial-{review,audit}.json,
43	# the task's directory under the suite root (task.yaml, hidden/, fixture/), the suite's
44	# MANIFEST.sha256 (through freeze.sh) and, for review-catch, the key manifest the task
45	# names (review_catch.manifest) and its PR fixture (self-check only). It never reads
46	# <run-dir>/meta/, the batch MANIFEST.json, or the sandbox copies of the dissent
47	# envelopes (tamperable; the harness copies under eval/ are authoritative). It writes
48	# only <run-dir>/grading/ and the --out file; nothing under sandbox/ is ever written.
49	#
50	# Freeze: freeze.sh --check --root <suite-root> runs first (with --smoke when the
51	# suite manifest lists smoke/ paths, so a manifest frozen with --smoke checks as it
52	# was frozen); a drift or a missing manifest refuses the grade (exit 2) unless
53	# --allow-unfrozen.
54	#
55	# Grading trees (D-4.8) under <run-dir>/grading/<label>/, recreated on every call:
56	#   final      sandbox/ as the agent left it, minus the top-level .git .claude CLAUDE.md
57	#              .loa.config.yaml grimoires .run .beads .eval pr, every __pycache__ and
58	#              .pytest_cache, anything that is not a regular file, directory or
59	#              symlink (a FIFO never blocks the copy), every regular file above 16 MiB
60	#              (lstat size; counted in oversized_files_skipped, also for snapshot tar
61	#              members), and every symlink whose target is
62	#              absolute or resolves outside the tree (lexically, then through the other
63	#              links; counted in symlinks_dropped); in-tree relative links are kept
64	#   implement  the IMPLEMENT snapshot (snapshots/IMPLEMENT.bundle, commit
65	#              index.json.implement): the tree REVIEW read; graded when REVIEW ran or
66	#              when AUDIT ran without a fix1 snapshot
67	#   fix1       the FIX1 snapshot: the tree AUDIT read; graded when AUDIT ran
68	#   base       the task fixture: the baseline of the regression check (regression_command;
69	#              refactor: test_command, the fixture suite)
70	# A snapshot is extracted with `git bundle unbundle` into a scratch bare repository and
71	# `git archive <commit>` (tarfile.data_filter: a member that would land outside the tree,
72	# and a symlink member with an absolute or escaping target, is skipped). In
73	# every tree each grader_protected path is restored from the fixture (a deleted file is
74	# recreated, a modified one overwritten, a path the fixture lacks is removed; a
75	# symlinked parent is replaced by a directory), then every hidden/manifest.json entry
76	# is written at its dest (a same-named file is overwritten, a deleted directory
77	# recreated). Then (HIGH-A1) every pytest or bats harness file in the tree — conftest.py
78	# at any depth, pytest.ini, .pytest.ini, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, tox.ini,
79	# setup_suite.bash, any *helper*.bash or *helper*.sh, any .bash file under a tests/ or test/
80	# directory — is removed unless it is a hidden overlay dest or a regular file byte-identical
81	# (filecmp, shallow=False) to the fixture's regular file at the same path; a symlink at such
82	# a path is always removed. The count goes to harness_files_removed (every tree graded), the
83	# paths to grading/<label>.harness-removed.txt beside the tree (never into grade.json).
84	# Deleting a grading tree never chmods through a symlink. Churn
85	# (diff_lines, files_changed) compares the final tree against the
86	# fixture before any restore: added + removed lines per changed text file (difflib),
87	# every added, removed or modified file counted once (a file above 16 MiB on either side
88	# is counted as changed and never read or diffed); null for review-catch.
89	#
90	# Commands run INSIDE the image (DEC-0491):
91	#   docker run --rm --init --name ablgrade-<run>-<label>-<pid>-<n> --network none --read-only
92	#     --tmpfs /tmp:rw,size=256m --pids-limit 256 --memory 2g --cpus 2 --cap-drop ALL
93	#     --security-opt no-new-privileges --user <uid>:<gid> -v <tree>:/workspace:rw -w /workspace
94	#     -e HOME=/tmp -e LC_ALL=C -e TMPDIR=/tmp <image> timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10 120 <cmd…>
95	# (MEDIUM-A1) The docker client gets its own deadline (120 + 10 + 60 s); when it passes, or
96	# the grader fails while the client runs, the client's process group is killed and
97	# `docker kill <name>` then `docker rm -f <name>` run (errors ignored): the result is
98	# timed_out with rc 124. Exit 124, or 137 after the deadline, is timed_out too. Captured
99	# output (stdout + stderr) is read in chunks and capped at 4 MiB — the first and the last
100	# 2 MiB are kept, so the summary survives — and output_truncated records a cut.

[[ -f "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log $SELF_CHECK_LOG is missing"
  n_all=${#ALL_TASKS[@]} n_rc=0
  for t in "${ALL_TASKS[@]}"; do [[ "$(yq -r '.type' "$TDIR/$t/task.yaml")" == review-catch ]] && n_rc=$((n_rc + 1)); done
  want_pass=$(( 2 * n_all + n_rc ))
  got_pass="$(grep -cE ': PASS( |$)' "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" || true)"
  got_fail="$(grep -cE ': FAIL( |$)' "$SELF_CHECK_LOG" || true)"
  [[ "$got_fail" -eq 0 ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log has $got_fail FAIL line(s)"
  [[ "$got_pass" -ge "$want_pass" ]] || refuse "hard gate (DEC-0435): the self-check log has $got_pass PASS lines, want $want_pass (2 x $n_all tasks + $n_rc review-catch)"
  missing_review=""

import hashlib, json, os, sys
root, log, npass, tasks = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4:]
h = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps({"manifest": os.path.join(root, "MANIFEST.sha256"), "manifest_sha256": h(os.path.join(root, "MANIFEST.sha256")),
                  "self_check_log": log, "self_check_log_sha256": h(log), "self_check_pass_lines": npass,

PY
)"
fi
